text: 1 'Therefore, behold! the days come, And the times shall hasten more than the former, And the seasons shall speed on more than those that are past, And the years shall pass more quickly than the present (years).

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 2 Therefore have I now taken away Zion, That I may the more speedily visit the world in its season.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 3 Now therefore hold fast in your heart everything that I command you, And seal it in the recesses of your mind.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 4 And then I will show you the judgment of My might, And My ways which are unsearchable.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 5 Go therefore and sanctify thyself seven days, and eat no bread, nor drink water, nor speak to anyone.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 6 And afterwards come to that place and I will reveal Myself to you, and speak true things with you, and I will give you commandment regarding the method of the times; for they are coming and tarry not.'

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: The Prayer of Baruch the Son of Neriah.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 1 And I went there and sat in the valley of Kidron in a cave of the earth, and I sanctified my soul there, and I ate no bread, yet I was not hungry, and I drank no water, yet I thirsted not, and I was there till the seventh day, as He had commanded me.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 2 And afterwards I came to that place where He had spoken with me.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 3 And it came to pass at sunset that my soul took much thought, and I began to speak in the presence of the Mighty One, and said:

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 4 'O you that have made the earth, hear me, that have fixed the firmament by the word, and have made firm the height of the heaven by the spirit, that have called from the beginning of the world that which did not yet exist, and they obey you.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 5 you that have commanded the air by Your nod, and have seen those things which are to be as those things which you are doing.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 6 you that rule with great thought the hosts that stand before you: also the countless holy beings, which you did make from the beginning, of flame and fire, which stand around Your throne you rule with indignation.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 7 To you only does this belong that you should do forthwith whatsoever you do wish.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 8 Who causes the drops of rain to rain by number upon the earth, and alone knows the consummation of the times before they come; have respect unto my prayer. For

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 9 you alone are able to sustain all who are, and those who have passed away, and those who are to be, those who sin, and those who are to righteous [as living (and) being past finding out]. For you alone do live immortal and past finding out, and know the number of mankind. And if in time many have sinned, yet others not a few have been righteous.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 12 you know where you preserve the end of those who have sinned, or the consummation of

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 13 those who have been righteous. For if there were this life only, which belongs to all men, nothing could be more bitter than this.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 14 For of what profit is strength that turns to sickness, Or fullness of food that turns to famine, Or beauty that turns to ugliness.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 15 For the nature of man is always changeable.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 16 For what we were formerly now we no longer are and what we now are we shall not afterwards remain.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 16 For if a consummation had not been prepared for all, in vain would have been their beginning. But regarding everything that comes from you do you inform me, and regarding everything about which I ask you, do you enlighten me.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 19 How long will that which is corruptible remain, and how long will the time of mortals be prospered, and until what time will those who transgress in the world be polluted with much wickedness?

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 20 Command therefore in mercy and accomplish all that you saidst you wouldst bring, that Your might may be made known to those who think that Your long-suffering is weakness.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 21 And show to those who know not, that everything that has befallen us and our city until now has been according to the long-suffering of Your power, because on account of Your name you have called us a beloved people.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 22 Bring to an end therefore henceforth mortality.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 23 And reprove accordingly the angel of death, and let Your glory appear, and let the might of Your beauty be known, and let Sheol be sealed so that from this time forward it may not receive the dead, and let the treasuries of souls restore those which are enclosed in them.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 24 For there have been many years like those that are desolate from the days of Abraham and Isaac and Jacob, and of all those who are like them, who sleep in the earth, on whose account you did say that you had created the world.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 25 And now quickly show Your glory, and do not defer what has been promised by you.'

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 26 And (when) I had completed the words of this prayer I was greatly weakened.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 1 And it came to pass after these things that lo! the heavens were opened, and I saw, and power was given to me, and a voice was beard from on high, and it said unto me:

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 2 Baruch, Baruch, why are you troubled?

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 3 He who travels by a road but does not complete it, or who departs by sea but does not arrive at the port, can he be comforted?

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 4 Or he who promises to give a present to another, but does not fulfill it, is it not robbery?

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 5 Or he who sows the earth, but does not reap its fruit in its season, does he not lose everything?

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 6 Or he who plants a plant unless it grows till the time suitable to it, does he who planted it expect to receive fruit from it?

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 7 Or a woman who has conceived, if she bring forth untimely, does she not assuredly slay her infant?

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 8 Or he who builds a house, if he does not roof it and complete it, can it be called a house? Tell Me that first.'

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 1 And I answered and said: Not so, O LORD, my Lord.'

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 2 And He answered and said unto me: 'Why therefore are you troubled about that which you know not, and why are you ill at ease about things in which you are ignorant?

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 3 For as you have not forgotten the people who now are and those who have passed away, so I remember those who are appointed to come.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 4 Because when Adam sinned and death was decreed against those who should be born, then the multitude of those who should be born was numbered, and for that number a place was prepared where the living might dwell and the dead might be guarded.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 5 Before therefore the number aforesaid is fulfilled, the creature will not live again [for My spirit is the creator of life], and Sheol will receive the dead.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 6 And again it is given to you to hear what things are to come after these times.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 7 For truly My redemption has drawn nigh, and is not far distant as aforetime.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 1 'For behold! the days come and the books shall be opened in which are written the sins of all those who have sinned, and again also the treasuries in which the righteousness of all those who have been righteous in creation is gathered.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 2 For it shall come to pass at that time that you shall see--and the many that are with you--the long-suffering of the Most High, which has been throughout all generations, who has been long-suffering towards all who are born, (alike) those who sin and (those who) are righteous.'

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 3 And I answered and said: 'But, behold! O Lord, no one knows the number of those things which have passed nor yet of those things which are to come.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 4 For I know indeed that which has befallen us, but what will happen to our enemies I know not, and when you will visit Your works.'

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 1 And He answered and said unto me: 'You too shall be preserved till that time till that sign which the Most High will work for the inhabitants of the earth in the end of days.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 2 This therefore shall be the sign.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 3 When a stupor shall seize the inhabitants of the earth, and they shall fall into many tribulations, and again when they shall fall into great torments. And it will come to pass when they say in their thoughts by reason of their much tribulation: "The Mighty 'One doth no longer remember the earth"--yes, it will come to pass when they abandon hope, that the time will then awake.'

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 1 And I answered and said: 'Will that tribulation which is to be continue a long time, and will that necessity embrace many years?'

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 26-30. The Twelve Woes that are to Come upon the Earth: The Messiah and the temporary Messianic Kingdom

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 1 And He answered and said unto me: 'Into twelve parts is that time divided, and each one of them is reserved for that which is appointed for it.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 2 In the first part there shall be the beginning of commotions.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 3 And in the second part (there shall be) slayings of the great ones.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 4 And in the third part the fall of many by death.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 5 And in the fourth part the sending of the sword.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 6 And in the fifth part famine and the withholding of rain.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 7 And in the sixth part earthquakes and terrors.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 8 [Wanting.]

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 9 And in the eighth part a multitude of specters and attacks of the Shedim.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 10 And in the ninth part the fall of fire.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 11 And in the tenth part rapine and much oppression.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 12 And in the eleventh part wickedness and unchastity.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 13 And in the twelfth part confusion from the mingling together of all those things aforesaid.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 14 For these parts of that time are reserved, and shall be mingled one with another and minister one to another.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 15 For some shall leave out some of their own, and receive (in its stead) from others, and some complete their own and that of others, so that those may not understand who are upon the earth in those days that this is the consummation of the times.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 1 Nevertheless, whoever understands shall then be wise.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 2 For the measure and reckoning of that time are two parts a week of seven weeks.'

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 3 And I answered and said: 'It is good for a man to come and behold, but it is better that he should not come lest he fall.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 4 [But I will say this also:

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 5 Will he who is incorruptible despise those things which are corruptible, and whatever befalls in the case of those things which are corruptible, so that he might look only to those things which are not corruptible?]

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 6 But if; O Lord, those things shall assuredly come to pass which you have foretold to me, so do you show this also unto me if indeed I have found grace in Your sight.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 7 Is it in one place or in one of the parts of the earth that those things are come to pass, or will the whole earth experience (them) ?'

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 1 And He answered and said unto me: 'Whatever will then befall (will befall) the whole earth; therefore all who live will experience (them).

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 2 For at that time I will protect only those who are found in those self-same days in this land.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 3 And it shall come to pass when all is accomplished that was to come to pass in those parts, that the Messiah shall then begin to be revealed.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 4 And Behemoth shall be revealed from his place and Leviathan shall ascend from the sea, those two great monsters which I created on the fifth day of creation, and shall have kept until that time; and then they shall be for food for all that are left.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 5 The earth also shall yield its fruit ten-thousandfold and on each (?) vine there shall be a thousand branches, and each branch shall produce a thousand clusters, and each cluster produce a thousand grapes, and each grape produce a cor of wine.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 6 And those who have hungered shall rejoice: moreover, also, they shall behold marvels every day.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 7 For winds shall go forth from before Me to bring every morning the fragrance of aromatic fruits, and at the close of the day clouds distilling the dew of health.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 8 And it shall come to pass at that self-same time that the treasury of manna shall again descend from on high, and they will eat of it in those years, because these are they who have come to the consummation of time.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 1 And it shall come to pass after these things, when the time of the advent of the Messiah is fulfilled, that He shall return in glory.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 2 Then all who have fallen asleep in hope of Him shall rise again. And it shall come to pass at that time that the treasuries will be opened in which is preserved the number of the souls of the righteous, and they shall come forth, and a multitude of souls shall be seen together in one assemblage of one thought, and the first shall rejoice and the last shall not be grieved.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 3 For they know that the time has come of which it is said, that it is the consummation of the times.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 4 But the souls of the wicked, when they behold all these things, shall then waste away the more.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 5 For they shall know that their torment has come and their perdition has arrived.'

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 1 And it came to pass after these things: that I went to the people and said unto them: 'Assemble unto me all your elders and I will speak words unto them.'

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 2 And they all assembled in the valley of the Kidron.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 3 And I answered and said unto them: Hear, O Israel, and I will speak to you, And give ear, O seed of Jacob, and I will instruct you.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 4 Forget not Zion, But hold in remembrance the anguish of Jerusalem.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 5 For lo! the days come, When everything that is shall become the prey of corruption And be as though it had not been.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 1 'But as for you, if you prepare your hearts, so as to sow in them the fruits of the law, it shall protect you in that time in which the Mighty One is to shake the whole creation.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 2 [Because after a little time the building of Zion will be shaken in order that it may be built again.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: But that building will not remain, but will again after a time be rooted out, and will remain desolate until the time.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 4 And afterwards it must be renewed in glory, and perfected for evermore.]

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 5 Therefore we should not be distressed so much over the evil which has now come as over that which is still to be.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 6 For there will be a greater trial than these two tribulations when the Mighty One will renew His creation.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 7 And now do not draw near to me for a few days, nor seek me till I come to you.'

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 8 And it came to pass when I had spoken to them all these words, that I, Baruch, went my way, and when the people saw me setting out, they lifted up their voice and lamented and said :

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 9 To where are you departing from us, Baruch, and are you forsaking us as a father who forsakes his orphan children, and departs from them?

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 1 'Are these the commands which your companion, Jeremiah the prophet, commanded you, and said unto you: "Look to this people till I go and make ready the rest of the brethren in Babylon against whom has gone forth the sentence that they should be led into captivity"? And now if you also forsake us, it were good for us all to die before you, and then that you should withdraw from us.'

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 1 And I answered and said unto the people: 'Far be it from me to forsake you or to withdraw from you, but I will only go unto the Holy of Holies to inquire of the Mighty One concerning you and concerning Zion, if in some respect I should receive more illumination: and after these things I will return to you.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 1 And I, Baruch, went to the holy place, and sat down upon the ruins and wept, and said:

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 2 'O that mine eyes were springs, And mine eyelids a fount of tears.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 3 For how shall I lament for Zion, And how shall I mourn for Jerusalem?

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 4 Because in that place where I am now prostrate, Of old the high priest offered holy sacrifices, And placed thereon an incense of fragrant odors.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 5 But now our glorying has been made into dust, And the desire of our soul into sand.'

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 1 And when I had said these things I fell asleep there, and I saw a vision in the night.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 2 And lo! a forest of trees planted on the plain, and lofty and rugged rocky mountains surrounded it, and that forest occupied much space.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 3 And lo! over against it arose a vine, and from under it there went forth a fountain peacefully.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 4 Now that fountain came to the forest and was (stirred) into great waves, and those waves submerged that forest, and suddenly they rooted out the greater part of that forest, and overthrew all the mountains which were round about it.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 5 And the height of the forest began to be made low, and the top of the mountains was made low and that fountain prevailed greatly, so that it left nothing of that great forest save one cedar only.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 6 Also when it had cast it down and had destroyed and rooted out the greater part of that forest, so that nothing was left of it, nor could its place be recognized, then that vine began to come with the fountain in peace and great tranquility, and it came to a place which was not far from that cedar, and they brought the cedar which had been cast down to it.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 7 And I beheld and lo! that vine opened its mouth and spoke and said to that cedar: Art you not that cedar which was left of the forest of wickedness, and by whose means wickedness persisted, and was wrought all those years, and goodness never.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 8 And you kept conquering that which was not yours, and to that which was your you did never show compassion, and you did keep extending your power over those who were far from you, and those who drew near you, you did hold fast in the toils of your wickedness, and you did uplift thyself always as one that could not be rooted out!

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 9 But now your time has sped and your hour is come.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 10 Do you also therefore depart, O cedar, after the forest, which departed before you, and become dust with it, and let your ashes be mingled together.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 11 And now recline in anguish and rest in torment till your last time come, in which you will come again, and be tormented still more.'

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 1 And after these things I saw that cedar burning, and the vine growing, itself and all around it, the plain full of unfading flowers. And I indeed awoke and arose.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 1 And I prayed and said: 'O LORD, my Lord, you do always enlighten those who are led by understanding.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 2 Your law is life, and Your wisdom is right guidance.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 3 Make known to me therefore the interpretation of this vision.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 4 For you know that my soul hath always walked in Your law, and from my (earliest) days I departed not from Your wisdom.'

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 1 And He answered and said unto me: 'Baruch, this is the interpretation of the vision which you have seen.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 2 As you have seen the great forest which lofty and rugged mountains surrounded, this is the word.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 3 Behold! the days come, and this kingdom will be destroyed which once destroyed Zion, and it will be subjected to that which comes after it.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 4 Moreover, that also again after a time will be destroyed, and another, a third, will arise, and that also will have dominion for its time, and will be destroyed.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 5 And after these things a fourth kingdom will arise, whose power will be harsh and evil far beyond those which were before it, and it will rule many times as the forests on the plain, and it will hold fast for times, and will exalt itself more than the cedars of Lebanon.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 6 And by it the truth will be hidden, and all those who are polluted with iniquity will flee to it, as evil beasts flee and creep into the forest.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 7 And it will come to pass when the time of its consummation that it should fall has approached, then the principate of My Messiah will be revealed, which is like the fountain and the vine, and when it is revealed it will root out the multitude of its host.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 8 And as touching that which you have seen, the lofty cedar, which was left of that forest, and the fact, that the vine spoke those words with it which you did hear, this is the word.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 1 The last leader of that time will be left alive, when the multitude of his hosts will be put to the sword, and he will be bound, and they will take him up to Mount Zion, and My Messiah will convict him of all his impieties, and will gather and set before him all the works of his hosts.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 2 And afterwards he will put him to death, and protect the rest of My people which shall be found in the place which I have chosen.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 3 And his principate will stand for ever, until the world of corruption is at an end, and until the times aforesaid are fulfilled.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 4 This is your vision, and this is its interpretation.'

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 1 And I answered and said: 'For whom and for how many shall these things be? or who will be worthy to live at that time?

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 2 For I will speak before you everything that I think, and I will ask of you regarding those things which I meditate.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 3 For lo! I see many of Your people who have withdrawn from Your covenant, and cast from them the yoke of Your law.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 4 But others again I have seen who have forsaken their vanity, and fled for refuge beneath Your wings.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 5 What therefore will be to them? or how will the last time receive them?

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 6 Or perhaps the time of these will assuredly be weighed, and as the beam inclines will they be judged accordingly?'

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 1 And He answered and said unto me: 'These things also will I show unto you.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 2 As for what you did say--"To whom will these things be, and how many (will they be)? "--to those who have believed there shall be the good which was spoken of aforetime, and to those who despise there shall be the contrary of these things.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 3 And as for what you did say regarding those who have drawn near and those who have withdrawn this in the word.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 4 As for those who were before subject, and afterwards withdrew and mingled themselves with the seed of mingled peoples, the time of these was the former, and was accounted as something exalted.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 5 And as for those who before knew not but afterwards knew life, and mingled (only) with the seed of the people which had separated itself, the time of these (is) the latter, and is accounted as something exalted.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 6 And time shall succeed to time and season to season, and one shall receive from another, and then with a view to the consummation shall everything be compared according to the measure of the times and the hours of the seasons.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 7 For corruption shall take those that belong to it, and life those that belong to it.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 8 And the dust shall be called, and there shall be said to it: "Give back that which is not yours, and raise up all that you have kept until its time".'

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 1 But, do thou, Baruch, direct your heart to that which has been said to you, And understand those things which have been shown to you; For there are many eternal consolations for you.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 2 For you shall depart from this place, And you shall pass from the regions which are now seen by you, And you shall forget whatever is corruptible, And shall not again recall those things which happen among mortals.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 3 Go therefore and command your people, and come to this place, and afterwards fast seven days, and then I will come to you and speak with you.'

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 1 And I, Baruch, went from thence, and came to my people, and I called my first-born son and [the Gedaliahs] my friends, and seven of the elders of the people, and I said unto them: Behold, I go unto my fathers According to the way of all the earth.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 3 But withdraw you not from the way of the law, But guard and admonish the people which remain, Lest they withdraw from the commandments of the Mighty One.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 4 For you see that He whom we serve is just, And our Creator is no respecter of persons.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 5 And see you what hath befallen Zion, And what hath happened to Jerusalem.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 6 For the judgment of the Mighty One shall (thereby) be made known, And His ways, which, though past finding out, are right.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 7 For if you endure and persevere in His fear, And do not forget His law, The times shall change over you for good. And you shall see the consolation of Zion.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 9 Because whatever is now is nothing, But that which shall be is very great. For everything that is corruptible shall pass away, And everything that dies shall depart, And all the present time shall be forgotten, Nor shall there be any remembrance of the present time, which is defiled with evils.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 10 For that which runs now runs unto vanity, And that which prospers shall quickly fall and be humiliated.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 11 For that which is to be shall be the object of desire, And for that which comes afterwards shall we hope; For it is a time that passes not away,

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 12 And the hour comes which abides for ever. And the new world (comes) which does not turn to corruption those who depart to its blessedness, And has no mercy on those who depart to torment, And leads not to perdition those who live in it.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 13 For these are they who shall inherit that time which has been spoken of, And theirs is the inheritance of the promised time.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 14 These are they who have acquired for themselves treasures of wisdom, And with them are found stores of understanding, And from mercy have they not withdrawn, And the truth of the law I have they preserved.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 15 For to them shall be given the world to come, But the dwelling of the rest who are many shall be in the fire.'

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 2 'Do you therefore so far as you are able instruct the people, for that labor is ours. For if you teach them, you will quicken them.'

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 1 And my son and the elders of the people answered and said unto me: 'Has the Mighty One humiliated us to such a degree As to take you from us quickly?

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 2 And truly we shall be in darkness, And there shall be no light to the people who are left,

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 3 For where again shall we seek the law, Or who will distinguish for us between death and life?'

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 4 And I said unto them: 'The throne of the Mighty One I cannot resist; Nevertheless, there shall not be wanting to Israel a wise man Nor a son of the law to the race of Jacob.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 5 But only prepare you your hearts, that you may obey the law, And be subject to those who in fear are wise and understanding; And prepare your souls that you may not depart from them.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 6 For if you do these things, Good tidings shall come unto you. [Which I before told you of; nor shall you fall into the torment, of which I testified to you before.'

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 7 But with regard to the word that I was to be taken I did not make (it) known to them or to my son.]

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 1 And when I had gone forth and dismissed them, I went there and said unto them: 'Behold! I go to Hebron: for thither the Mighty One hath sent me.'

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 2 And I came to that place where the word had been spoken unto me, and I sat there, and fasted seven days.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 1 And it came to pass after the seventh day, that I prayed before the Mighty One and said

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 2 'O my Lord, you summon the advent of the times, And they stand before you; You cause the power of the ages to pass away,And they do not resist you; You arrange the method of the seasons, And they obey you.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 3 You alone know the duration of the generations, And you reveal not Your mysteries to many.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 4 You make known the multitude of the fire, And you weigh the lightness of the wind.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 5 You explore the limit of the heights, And you scrutinize the depths of the darkness.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 6 You care for the number which pass away that they may be preserved, And you prepare an abode for those that are to be.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 7 You remember the beginning which you have made, And the destruction that is to be You forget not.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 8 With nods of fear and indignation You command the flames, And they change into spirits, And with a word you quicken that which was not, And with mighty power you hold that which has not yet come.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 9 You instruct created things in the understanding of you, And you make wise the spheres so as to minister in their orders.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 10 Armies innumerable stand before you And minister in their orders quietly at Your nod.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 11 Hear Your servant And give ear to my petition.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 12 For in a little time are we born, And in a little time do we return.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 13 But with you hours are as a time, And days as generations.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 14 Be not therefore wroth with man; for he is nothing

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 15 And take not account of our works; For what are we? And we depart not of our own will.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 16 For we said not to our parents, "Beget us, Nor did we send to Sheol and say, "Receive us."

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 17 What therefore is our strength that we should bear Your wrath, Or what are we that we should endure Your judgment?

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 18 Protect us in Your compassions, And in Your mercy help us.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 19 Behold the little ones that are subject unto you, And save all that draw near unto you: And destroy not the hope of our people, And cut not short the times of our aid.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 20 For this is the nation which you have chosen, And these are the people, to whom you find no equal.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 21 But I will speak now before you, And I will say as my heart thinks.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 22 In you do we trust, for lo! Your law is with us, And we know that we shall not fall so long as we keep Your statutes.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 23 [To all time are we blessed at all events in this that we have not mingled with the Gentiles.]

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 24 For we are all one celebrated people, Who have received one law from One: And the law which is amongst us will aid us, And the surpassing wisdom which is in us will help us.'

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 25 And when I had prayed and said these things, I was greatly weakened.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 26 And He answered and said unto me: 'You have prayed simply, O Baruch, And all your words have been heard.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 27 But My judgment exacts its own And My law exacts its rights.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 28 For from your words I will answer you, And from your prayer I will speak to you.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 29 For this is as follows: he that is corrupted is not at all; he has both wrought iniquity so far as lie could do anything, and has not remembered My goodness, nor accepted My long-suffering.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 30 Therefore you shall surely be taken up, as I before told you.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 31 For that time shall arise which brings affliction; for it shall come and pass by with quick vehemence, and it shall be turbulent coming in the heat of indignation.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 32 And it shall come to pass in those days that all the inhabitants of the earth shall be moved one against another, because they know not that My judgment has drawn nigh.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 33 For there shall not be found many wise at that time, And the intelligent shall be but a few: Moreover, even those who know shall most of all be silent.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 34 And there shall be many rumors and tidings not a few, And the doing of phantasms shall be manifest, And promises not a few be recounted, Some of them (shall prove) idle, And some of them shall be confirmed.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 35 And honor shall be turned into shame, And strength humiliated into contempt, And probity destroyed, And beauty shall become ugliness.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 36 And many shall say to many at that time: "Where hath the multitude of intelligence hidden itself, And whither hath the multitude of wisdom removed itself?"

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 37 And whilst they are meditating these things, Then envy shall arise in those who had not thought aught of themselves (?) And passion shall seize him that is peaceful, And many shall be stirred up in anger to injure many, And they shall rouse up armies in order to shed blood, And in the end they shall perish together with them.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 38 And it shall come to pass at the self-same time, That a change of times shall manifestly appeal to every man, Because in all those times they polluted themselves And they practiced oppression, And walked every man in his own works, And remembered not the law of the Mighty One.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 39 Therefore a fire shall consume their thoughts, And in flame shall the meditations of their reins be tried; For the Judge shall come and will not tarry.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 40 Because each of the inhabitants of the earth knew when he was transgressing. But My Law they knew not by reason of their pride.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 41 But many shall then assuredly weep, Yea, over the living more than over the dead.'

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 42 And I answered and said: 'O Adam, what have you done to all those who are born from you? And what will be said to the first Eve who hearkened to the serpent?

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 43 For all this multitude are going to corruption, Nor is there any numbering of those whom the fire devours.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 44 But again I will speak in Your presence.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 45 You, O LORD, my Lord, know what is in Your creature.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 46 For you did of old command the dust to produce Adam, and you know the number of those who are born from him, and how far they have sinned before you, who have existed and not confessed you as their Creator.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 47 And as regards all these their end shall convict them, and Your law which they have transgressed shall requite them on Your day.'

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 48 ['But now let us dismiss the wicked and inquire about the righteous.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 49 And I will recount their blessedness And not be silent in celebrating their glory, which is reserved for them.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 50 For assuredly as in a little time in this transitory world in which you live, you have endured much labor, So in that world to which there is no end, you shall receive great light.']

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 1 'Nevertheless, I Will again ask from you, O Mighty One, yea, I will ask made all things.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 2 "In what shape will those live who live in Your day? Or how will the splendor of those who (are) after that time continue?

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 3 Will they then resume this form of the present, And put on these entrammelling members, Which are now involved in evils, And in which evils are consummated, Or will you perchance change these things which have been in the world

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: As also the world?"

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 1 And He answered and said unto me: 'Hear, Baruch, this word, And write in the remembrance of your heart all that you shall learn.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 2 For the earth shall then assuredly restore the dead, [Which it now receives, in order to preserve them]. It shall make no change in their form, But as it has received, so shall it restore them, And as I delivered them unto it, so also shall it raise them.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 3 For then it will be necessary to show the living that the dead have come to life again, and that those who had departed have returned (again).

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 4 And it shall come to pass, when they have severally recognized those whom they now know, then judgment shall grow strong, and those things which before were spoken of shall come.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 1 And it shall come to pass, when that appointed day has gone by, that then shall the aspect of those who are condemned be afterwards changed, and the glory of those who are justified.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 2 For the aspect of those who now act wickedly shall become worse than it is, as they shall suffer torment.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 3 Also (as for) the glory of those who have now been justified in My law, who have had understanding in their life, and who have planted in their heart the root of wisdom, then their splendor shall be glorified in changes, and the form of their face shall be turned into the light of their beauty, that they may be able to acquire and receive the world which does not die, which is then promised to them.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 4 For over this above all shall those who come then lament, that they rejected My law, and stopped their ears that they might not hear wisdom or receive understanding.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 5 When therefore they see those, over whom they are now exalted, (but) who shall then be exalted and glorified more than they, they shall respectively be transformed, the latter into the splendor of angels, and the former shall yet more waste away in wonder at the visions and in the beholding of the forms.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 6 For they shall first behold and afterwards depart to be tormented.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 7 But those who have been saved by their works, And to whom the law has been now a hope, And understanding an expectation, And wisdom a confidence, Shall wonders appear in their time.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 8 For they shall behold the world which is now invisible to them, And they shall behold the time which is now hidden from them:

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 9 And time shall no longer age them.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 10 For in the heights of that world shall they dwell, And they shall be made like unto the angels, And be made equal to the stars, And they shall be changed into every form they desire, From beauty into loveliness, And from light into the splendor of glory.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 11 For there shall be spread before them the extents of Paradise, and there shall be shown to them the beauty of the majesty of the living creatures which are beneath the throne, and all the armies of the angels, who are now held fast by My word, lest they should appear, and] are held fast by a command, that they may stand in their places till their advent comes.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 12 Moreover, there shall then be excellency in the righteous surpassing that in the angels.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 13 For the first shall receive the last, those whom they were expecting, and the last those of whom they used to hear that they had passed away.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 14 For they have been delivered from this world of tribulation, And laid down the burthen of anguish.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 15 For what then have men lost their life, And for what have those who were on the earth exchanged their soul?

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 16 For then they chose (not) for themselves this time, Which, beyond the reach of anguish, could not pass away: But they chose for themselves that time, Whose issues are full of lamentations and evils, And they denied the world which ages not those who come to it, And they rejected the time of glory, So that they shall not come to the honor of which I told you before.'

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 1 And I answered and said: 'How can we forget those for whom woe is then reserved?

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 2 And why therefore do we again mourn for those who die? Or why do we weep for those who depart to Sheol?

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 3 Let lamentations be reserved for the beginning of that coming torment, And let tears be laid up for the advent of the destruction of that time.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 4 [But even in the face of these things will I speak.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 5 And as for the righteous, what will they do now?

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 6 Rejoice you in the suffering which you now suffer: For why do you look for the decline of your enemies?

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 7 Make ready your soul for that which is reserved for you, And prepare your souls for the reward which is laid up for you.']

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 53. The Vision of the Cloud with black and white Waters

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 1 And when I had said these things I fell asleep there, and I saw a vision, and lo! a cloud was ascending from a very great sea, and I kept gazing upon it) and lo! it was full of waters white and black, and there were many colors in those self-same waters, and as it were the likeness of great lightning was seen at its summit.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 2 And I saw the cloud passing swiftly in quick courses, and it covered all the earth.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 3 And it came to pass after these things that that cloud began to pour upon the earth the waters that were in it.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 4 And I saw that there was not one and the same likeness in the waters which descended from it.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 5 For in the first beginning they were black and many (Or a time, and afterwards I saw that the waters became bright, but they were not many, and after these things again I saw black (waters), and after these things again bright, and again black and again bright.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 6 Now this was done twelve times, but the black were always more numerous than the bright.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 7 And it came to pass at the end of the cloud, that lo! it rained black waters, and they were darker than had been all those waters that were before, and fire was mingled with them, and where those waters descended, they wrought devastation and destruction.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 8 And after these things I saw how that lightning which I had seen on the summit of the cloud, seized hold of it and hurled it to the earth.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 9 Now that lightning shone exceedingly, so as to illuminate the whole earth, and it healed those regions where the last waters had descended and wrought devastation.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 10 And it took hold of the whole earth, and had dominion over it.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 11 And I saw after these things, and lo! twelve rivers were ascending from the sea, and they began to surround that lightning and to become subject to it.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 12 And by reason of my fear I awoke.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 1 And I besought the Mighty One, and said: 'You alone, O Lord, know of aforetime the deep things of the world, And the things which befall in their times You bring about by Your word, And against the works of the inhabitants of the earth you do hasten the beginnings of the times, And the end of the seasons you alone know.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 2 (You) for whom nothing is too hard, But who do everything easily by a nod:

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 3 (You) to whom the depths come as the heights, And whose word the beginnings of the ages serve:

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 4 (You) who reveal to those who fear you what is prepared for them, That thenceforth they may be comforted.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 5 You show great acts to those who know not; You break up the enclosure of those who are ignorant, And lightest up what is dark, And reveal what is hidden to the pure, [Who in faith have submitted themselves to you and Your law.]

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 6 You have shown to Your servant this vision; Reveal to me also its interpretation.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 7 For I know that as regards those things wherein I besought you, I have received a response, And as regards what I besought, you did reveal to me with what voice I should praise you, And from what members I should cause praises and hallelujahs to ascend to you.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 8 For if my members were mouths, And the hairs of my head voices, Even so I could not give you the reward of praise, Nor laud you as is befitting, Nor could I recount Your praise, Nor tell the glory of Your beauty.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 9 For what am I amongst men, Or why am I reckoned amongst those who are more excellent than I, That I have heard all these marvelous things from the Most High, And numberless promises from Him who created me?

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 10 Blessed be my mother among those that bear, And praised among women be she that bare me.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 11 For I will not be silent in praising the Mighty One, And with the voice of praise I will recount His marvelous deeds.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 12 For who doeth like unto Your marvelous deeds, O God, Or who comprehend Your deep thought of life.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 13 For with Your counsel you do govern all the creatures which Your right hand has created And you have established every fountain of light beside you, And the treasures of wisdom beneath Your throne have you prepared.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 14 And justly do they perish who have not loved Your law, And the torment of judgment shall await those who have not submitted themselves to Your power.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 15 For though Adam first sinned And brought untimely death upon all, Yet of those who were born from him Each one of them has prepared for his own soul torment to come, And again each one of them has chosen for himself glories to come.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 16 [For assuredly he who believeth will receive reward.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 17 But now, as for you, you wicked that now are, turn you to destruction, because you shall speedily be visited, in that formerly you rejected the understanding of the Most High.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 18 For His works have not taught you, Nor has the skill of His creation which is at all times persuaded you.]

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 19 Adam is therefore not the cause, save only of his own soul, But each of us has been the Adam of his own soul.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 20 But do You, O Lord, expound to me regarding those things which you have revealed to me, And inform me regarding that which I besought you.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 21 For at the consummation of the world vengeance shall be taken upon those who have done wickedness according to their wickedness, And you will glorify the faithful according to their faithfulness.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 22 For those who are amongst your own you rule, And those who sin you blot out from amongst your own.'

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 1 And it came to pass when I had finished speaking the words of this prayer, that I sat there under a tree, that I might rest in the shade of the branches.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 2 And I wondered and was astonished, and pondered in my thoughts regarding the multitude of goodness which sinners who are upon the earth have rejected, and regarding the great torment which they have despised, though

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 3 they knew that they should be tormented because of the sin they had committed. And when I was pondering on these things and the like, lo! the angel Ramiel who presides over true visions was sent to me, and he said unto me:

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 4 'Why does your heart trouble you, Baruch, and why does your thought disturb you?

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 5 For if owing to the report which you have only heard of judgment you are so moved, What (wilt you be) when you shall see it manifestly with your eyes?

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 6 And if with the expectation wherewith you do expect the day of the Mighty One you are so overcome, What (wilt you be) when you shall come to its advent?

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 7 And, if at the word of the announcement of the torment of those who have done foolishly you are so wholly distraught, How much more when the event will reveal marvelous things?

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 8 And if you have heard tidings of the good and evil things which are then coming and are grieved, What (wilt you be) when you shall behold what the majesty will reveal, Which shall convict these and cause those to rejoice.'

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 1 'Nevertheless, because you have besought the Most High to reveal to you the interpretation of the vision which you have seen, I have been sent to tell you.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 2 And the Mighty One hath assuredly made known to you the methods of the times that have passed, and of those that are destined to pass in His world from the beginning of its creation even unto its consummation, of those things which (are) deceit and of those which (are) in truth.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 3 For as you did see a great cloud which ascended from the sea, and went and covered the earth, this is the duration of the world (= ????) which the Mighty One made when he took counsel to make the world.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 4 And it came to pass when the word had gone forth from His presence, that the duration of the world had come into being in a small degree, and was established according to the multitude of the intelligence of Him who sent it.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 5 And as you did previously see on the summit of the cloud black waters which descended previously on the earth, this is the transgression wherewith Adam the first man transgressed.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 6 For [since] when he transgressed Untimely death came into being, Grief was named And anguish was prepared, And pain was created, And trouble consummated, And disease began to be established, And Sheol kept demanding that it should be renewed in blood, And the begetting of children was brought about, And the passion of parents produced, And the greatness of humanity was humiliated, And goodness languished.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 7 What therefore can be blacker or darker than these things?

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 8 This is the beginning of the black waters which you have seen.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 9 And from these black (waters) again were black derived, and the darkness of darkness was produced.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 10 For he became a danger to his own soul: even to the angels

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 11 For, moreover, at that time when he was created, they enjoyed liberty.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 12 And became he a danger some of them descended, and mingled with the women.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 13 And then those who did so were tormented in chains.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 14 But the rest of the multitude of the angels, of which there is (no) number, restrained themselves.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 15 And those who dwelt on the earth perished together (with them) through the waters of the deluge.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 16 These are the black first waters.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 1 And after these (waters) you did see bright waters: this is the fount of Abraham, also his generations and advent of his son, and of his son's son, and of those like them.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 2 Because at that time the unwritten law was named amongst them,

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And the works of the commandments were then fulfilled,

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And belief in the coming judgment was then generated,

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And hope of the world that was to be renewed was then built up,

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And the promise of the life that should come hereafter was implanted.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 3 These are the bright waters, which you have seen.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 1 'And the black third waters which you have seen, these are the mingling of all sins, which the nations afterwards wrought after the death of those righteous men, and the wickedness of the land of Egypt, wherein they did wickedly in the service wherewith they made their sons to serve.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 2 Nevertheless, these also perished at last.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 1 'And the bright fourth waters which you have seen are the advent of Moses and Aaron and Miriam and Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb and of all those like them.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 2 For at that time the lamp of the eternal law shone on all those who sat in darkness, which announced to them that believe the promise of their reward, and to them that deny, the torment of fire which is reserved for them.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 3 But also the heavens at that time were shaken from their place, and those who were under the throne of the Mighty One were perturbed, when He was taking Moses unto Himself.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 4 For He showed him many admonitions together with the principles of the law and the consummation of the times, as also to you, and likewise the pattern of Zion and its measures, in the pattern of which the sanctuary of the present time was to be made.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 5 But then also He showed to him the measures of the fire, also the depths of the abyss, and the weight of the winds, and the number of the drops of rain:

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 6 And the suppression of anger, and the multitude of long-suffering, and the truth of judgment:

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 7 And the root of wisdom, and the riches of understanding, and the fount of knowledge:

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 8 And the height of the air, and the greatness of Paradise, and the consummation of the ages, and the beginning of the day of judgment:

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 9 And the number of the offerings, and the earths which have not yet come:

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 10 And the mouth of Gehenna, and the station of vengeance, and the place of faith, and the region of

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 11 hope: And the likeness of future torment, and the multitude of innumerable angels, and the flaming hosts, and the splendor of the lightnings, and the voice of the thunders, and the orders of the chiefs of the angels, and the treasuries of light, and the changes of the times, and the investigations of the law.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 12 These are the bright fourth waters which you have seen.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 1 And the black fifth waters which you have seen raining are the works which the Amorites wrought, and the spells of their incantations which they wrought, and the wickedness of their mysteries, and the mingling of their pollution.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 2 But even Israel was then polluted by sins in the days of the judges, though they saw many signs which were from Him who made them.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 1 And the bright sixth waters which thru did see, this is the time in which David and Solomon were born.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 2 And there was at that time the building of Zion, And the dedication of the sanctuary, And the shedding of much blood of the nations that sinned then, And many offerings which were offered then in the dedication of the sanctuary.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 3 And peace and tranquility existed at that time,

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 4 And wisdom was heard in the assembly: And the riches of understanding were magnified in the congregations,

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 5 And the holy festivals were fulfilled in blessedness and in much joy.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 6 And the judgment of the rulers was then seen to be without guile,

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And the righteousness of the precepts of the Mighty One was accomplished with truth.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 7 And the land [which] was then beloved by the Lord, And because its inhabitants sinned not, it was glorified beyond all lands, And the city Zion ruled then over all lands and regions.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 8 These are the bright waters which you have seen.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 1 And the black seventh waters which you have seen, this is the perversion (brought about) by the counsel of Jeroboam, who took counsel to make two calves of gold:

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 2 And all the iniquities which kings who were after him iniquitously wrought.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 3 And the curse of Jezebel and the worship of idols which Israel practiced at that time.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 4 And the withholding of rain, and the famines which occurred until women eat the fruit of their wombs.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 5 And the time of their captivity which came upon the nine tribes and a half, because they were in many sins.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 6 And Shalmanezzar king of Assyria came and led them away captive.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 7 But regarding the Gentiles it were tedious to tell how they always wrought impiety and wickedness, and never wrought righteousness.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 8 These are the black seventh waters which you have seen.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 1 'And the bright eighth waters which you have seen, this is the rectitude and uprightness of Hezekiah king of Judah and the grace (of God) which came upon him.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 2 For when Sennacherib was stirred up in order that he might perish, and his wrath troubled him in order that he might thereby perish, for the multitude also of the nations which were with him.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 3 When, moreover, Hezekiah the king heard those things which the king of Assyria was devising, (i.e.) to come and seize him and destroy his people, the two and a half tribes which remained: nay, more he wished to overthrow Zion also: then Hezekiah trusted in his works, and had hope in his righteousness, and spoke with the Mighty One and said:

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 4 "Behold, for lo! Sennacherib is prepared to destroy us, and he will be boastful and uplifted when he has destroyed Zion."

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 5 And the Mighty One heard him, for Hezekiah was wise, And He had respect unto his prayer, because he was righteous.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 6 And thereupon the Mighty One commanded Ramiel His angel who speaks with you.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 7 And I went forth and destroyed their multitude, the number of whose chiefs only was a hundred and eighty-five thousand, and each one of them had an equal number (at his command).

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 8 And at that time I burned their bodies within, but their raiment and arms I preserved outwardly, in order that the still more wonderful deeds of the Mighty One might appear, and that thereby His name might be spoken of throughout the whole earth.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 9 And Zion was saved and Jerusalem delivered: Israel also was freed from tribulation.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 10 And all those who were in the holy land rejoiced, and the name of the Mighty One was glorified so that it was spoken of

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 11 These are the bright waters which you have seen.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 1 'And the black ninth waters which you have seen, this is all the wickedness which was in the days of Manasseh the son of Hezekiah.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 2 For he wrought much impiety, and he slew the righteous, and he wrested judgment, and he shed the blood of the innocent, and wedded women he violently polluted, and he overturned the altars, and destroyed their offerings, and drove forth their priests lest they should minister in the sanctuary.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 3 And he made an image with five faces: four of them looked to the four winds, and the fifth on the summit of the image as ah adversary of the zeal of the Mighty One.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 4 And then wrath went forth from the presence of the Mighty One to the intent that Zion should be rooted out, as also it befell in your days. But also against the two tribes and a half went forth a decree that they should also be led away captive, as you have now seen.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 5 And to such a degree did the impiety of Manasseh increase, that it removed the praise of the Most High from the sanctuary.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 7 On this account Manasseh was at that time named 'the impious," and finally his abode was in the fire.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 8 For though his prayer was heard with the Most High, finally, when he was cast into the brazen horse and the brazen horse was melted, it served as a sign unto him for the hour.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 9 For he had not lived perfectly, for he was not worthy--but that thenceforward he might know by whom finally he should be tormented.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 10 For he who is able to benefit is also able to torment.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 1 'Thus, moreover, did Manasseh act impiously, and thought that in his time the Mighty One would not inquire into these things.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 2 These are the black ninth waters which you have seen.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 1 'And the bright tenth waters which you have seen: this is the purity of the generations of Josiah king of Judah, who was the only one at the time who submitted himself to the Mighty One with all his heart and with all his soul.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 2 And he cleansed the land from idols, and hallowed all the vessels which had been polluted, and restored the offerings to the altar, and raised the horn of the holy, and exalted the righteous, and honored all that were wise in understanding, and brought back the priests to their ministry, and destroyed and removed the magicians and enchanters and necromancers from the land.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 3 And not only did he slay the impious that were living, but they also took from the sepulchers the bones of the dead and burned them with fire.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 4 [And the festivals and the Sabbaths he established in their sanctity], and their polluted ones he burnt in the fire, and the lying prophets which deceived the people, these also he burnt in the fire, and the people who listened to them when they were living, he cast them into the brook Kidron, and heaped stones upon them.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 5 And he was zealous with zeal for the Mighty One with all his soul, and he alone was firm in the law at that time, so that he left none that was uncircumcised, or that wrought impiety in all the land, all the days of his life.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 6 Therefore he shall receive an eternal reward, and he shall be glorified with the Mighty One beyond many at a later time.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 7 For on his account and on account of those who are like him were the honorable glories, of which you were told before, created and prepared. These arc the bright waters which you have seen.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 1 'And the black eleventh waters which you have seen: this is the calamity which is now befalling "Zion.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 2 Do you think that there is no anguish to the angels in the presence of the Mighty One, That Zion was so delivered up, And that lo! the Gentiles boast in their hearts, And assemble before their idols and say, "She is trodden down who oftentimes trod down, And she has been reduced to servitude who reduced (others)"?

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 3 Dost you think that in these things the Most High rejoices, Or that His name is glorified?

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 4 [But how will it serve towards His righteous judgment?]

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 5 Yet after these things shall the dispersed among the Gentiles be taken hold of by tribulation, And in shame shall they dwell in every place.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 6 Because so far as Zion is delivered up And Jerusalem laid waste, Shall idols prosper in the cities of the Gentiles, And the vapor of the smoke of the incense of the righteousness which is by the law is extinguished in Zion, And in the region of Zion in every place lo! there is the smoke of impiety.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 7 But the king of Babylon will arise who has now destroyed Zion, And he will boast over the people, And he will speak great things in his heart in the presence of the Most High.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 8 But he also shall fall at last. These are the black waters.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 2 'And the bright twelfth waters which you have seen: this is the word. For after these things time will come when your people shall fall into distress, so that they shall all run the risk of perishing together.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 3 Nevertheless, they will be saved, and their enemies will fall in their presence.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 4 And they will have in (due) time much joy.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 5 And at that time after a little interval Zion will again be rebuilt, and its offerings will again be restored, and the priests will return to their ministry, and also the Gentiles will come to glorify it.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 6 Nevertheless, not fully as in the beginning.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 7 But it will come to pass after these things that there will be the fall of many nations.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 8 These are the bright waters which you have seen.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 1 'For the last waters which you have seen which were darker than all that were before them, those which were after the twelfth number, which were collected together, belong to the whole world.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 2 For the Most High made division from the beginning, because He alone knows what will befall.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 3 For as to the enormities and the impieties which should be wrought before Him, He foresaw six kinds of them.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 4 And of the good works of the righteous which should be accomplished before Him, He foresaw six kinds of them, beyond those which He should work at the consummation of the age.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 5 On his account there were not black waters with black, nor bright with bright; for it is the consummation.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 1 'Hear therefore the interpretation of the last black waters which are to come [after the black]: this the word.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: 2 Behold! the days come, and it shall be when the time of the age has ripened, And the harvest of its evil and good seeds has come, That the Mighty One will bring upon the earth and its inhabitants and upon its rulers Perturbation of spirit and stupor of heart.

title: 2 Baruch (Syriac Apocalypse of Baruch)
