title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesus said, “Become passersby.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: His disciples said to him, “Who are you to say these things to us?”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: “You don’t realize who I am from what I say to you, but you’ve become like those Judeans who either love the tree but hate its fruit, or love the fruit but hate the tree.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesus said, “Whoever blasphemes the Father will be forgiven, and whoever blasphemes the Son will be forgiven, but whoever blasphemes the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven, neither on earth nor in heaven.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesus said, “Grapes aren’t harvested from thorns, nor are figs gathered from thistles, because they don’t produce fruit. [A person who’s good] brings good things out of their treasure, and a person who’s [evil] brings evil things out of their evil treasure. They say evil things because their heart is full of evil.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesus said, “From Adam to John the Baptizer, no one’s been born who’s so much greater than John the Baptizer that they shouldn’t avert their eyes. But I say that whoever among you will become a little child will know the kingdom and become greater than John.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesus said, “It’s not possible for anyone to mount two horses or stretch two bows, and it’s not possible for a servant to follow two leaders, because they’ll respect one and despise the other.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: “No one drinks old wine and immediately wants to drink new wine. And new wine isn’t put in old wineskins, because they’d burst. Nor is old wine put in new wineskins, because it’d spoil.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: “A new patch of cloth isn’t sewn onto an old coat, because it’d tear apart.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesus said, “If two make peace with each other in a single house, they’ll say to the mountain, ‘Go away,’ and it will.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesus said, “Blessed are those who are one – those who are chosen, because you’ll find the kingdom. You’ve come from there and will return there.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesus said, “If they ask you, ‘Where do you come from?’ tell them, ‘We’ve come from the light, the place where light came into being by itself, [established] itself, and appeared in their image.’

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: “If they ask you, ‘Is it you?’ then say, ‘We are its children, and we’re chosen by our living Father.’

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: “If they ask you, ‘What’s the sign of your Father in you?’ then say, ‘It’s movement and rest.’”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: His disciples said to him, “When will the dead have rest, and when will the new world come?”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: He said to them, “What you’re looking for has already come, but you don’t know it.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: His disciples said to him, “Twenty-four prophets have spoken in Israel, and they all spoke of you.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: He said to them, “You’ve ignored the Living One right in front of you, and you’ve talked about those who are dead.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: His disciples said to him, “Is circumcision useful, or not?”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: He said to them, “If it were useful, parents would have children who are born circumcised. But the true circumcision in spirit has become profitable in every way.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesus said, “Blessed are those who are poor, for yours is the kingdom of heaven.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesus said, “Whoever doesn’t hate their father and mother can’t become my disciple, and whoever doesn’t hate their brothers and sisters and take up their cross like I do isn’t worthy of me.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesus said, “Whoever has known the world has found a corpse. Whoever has found a corpse, of them the world isn’t worthy.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesus said, “My Fathers’ kingdom can be compared to someone who had [good] seed. Their enemy came by night and sowed weeds among the good seed. The person didn’t let anyone pull out the weeds, ‘so that you don’t pull out the wheat along with the weeds,’ they said to them. ‘On the day of the harvest, the weeds will be obvious. Then they’ll be pulled out and burned.’”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesus said, “Blessed is the person who’s gone to a lot of trouble. They’ve found life.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesus said, “Look for the Living One while you’re still alive. If you die and then try to look for him, you won’t be able to.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: They saw a Samaritan carrying a lamb to Judea. He said to his disciples, “What do you think he’s going to do with that lamb?”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: They said to him, “He’s going to kill it and eat it.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: He said to them, “While it’s living, he won’t eat it, but only after he kills it and it becomes a corpse.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: They said, “He can’t do it any other way.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: He said to them, “You, too, look for a resting place, so that you won’t become a corpse and be eaten.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesus said, “Two will rest on a couch. One will die, the other will live.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Salome said, “Who are you, Sir, to climb onto my couch and eat off my table as if you’re from someone?”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesus said to her, “I’m the one who exists in equality. Some of what belongs to my Father was given to me.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: “I’m your disciple.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: “So I’m telling you, if someone is /equal\, they’ll be full of light; but if they’re divided, they’ll be full of darkness.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesus said, “I tell my mysteries to [those who are worthy of my] mysteries. Don’t let your left hand know what your right hand is doing.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesus said, “There was a rich man who had much money. He said, ‘I’ll use my money to sow, reap, plant, and fill my barns with fruit, so that I won’t need anything.’ That’s what he was thinking to himself, but he died that very night. Anyone who has ears to hear should hear!”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesus said, “Someone was planning on having guests. When dinner was ready, they sent their servant to call the visitors.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: “The servant went to the first and said, ‘My master invites you.’

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: “They said, ‘Some merchants owe me money. They’re coming tonight. I need to go and give them instructions. Excuse me from the dinner.’

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: “The servant went to another one and said, ‘My master invites you.’

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: “They said, “I’ve just bought a house and am needed for the day. I won’t have time.’

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: “The servant went to another one and said, ‘My master invites you.’

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: “They said, ‘My friend is getting married and I’m going to make dinner. I can’t come. Excuse me from the dinner.’

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: “The servant went to another one and said, ‘My master invites you.’

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: “They said, “I’ve just bought a farm and am going to collect the rent. I can’t come. Excuse me.’

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: “The servant went back and told the master, ‘The ones you’ve invited to the dinner have excused themselves.’

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: “The master said to their servant, ‘Go out to the roads and bring whomever you find so that they can have dinner.’

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: “Buyers and merchants won’t [enter] the places of my Father.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: He said, “A [creditor] owned a vineyard. He leased it out to some sharecroppers to work it so he could collect its fruit.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: “He sent his servant so that the sharecroppers could give him the fruit of the vineyard. They seized his servant, beat him, and nearly killed him.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: “The servant went back and told his master. His master said, ‘Maybe he just didn’t know them.’ He sent another servant, but the tenants beat that one too.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: “Then the master sent his son, thinking, ‘Maybe they’ll show some respect to my son.’

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: “Because they knew that he was the heir of the vineyard, the sharecroppers seized and killed him. Anyone who has ears to hear should hear!”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesus said, “Show me the stone the builders rejected; that’s the cornerstone.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesus said, “Whoever knows everything, but is personally lacking, lacks everything.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesus said, “Blessed are you when you’re hated and persecuted, and no place will be found where you’ve been persecuted.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesus said, “Blessed are those who’ve been persecuted in their own hearts. They’ve truly known the Father. Blessed are those who are hungry, so that their stomachs may be filled.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesus said, “If you give birth to what’s within you, what you have within you will save you. If you don’t have that within [you], what you don’t have within you [will] kill you.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesus said, “I’ll destroy [this] house, and no one will be able to build it […]”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: [Someone said to him], “Tell my brothers to divide our inheritance with me.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: He said to him, “Who made me a divider?”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: He turned to his disciples and said to them, “Am I really a divider?”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesus said, “The harvest really is plentiful, but the workers are few. So pray that the Lord will send workers to the harvest.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: He said, “Lord, many are gathered around the well, but there’s nothing to drink.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesus said, “Many are waiting at the door, but those who are one will enter the bridal chamber.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesus said, “The Father’s kingdom can be compared to a merchant with merchandise who found a pearl. The merchant was wise; they sold their merchandise and bought that single pearl for themselves.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: “You, too, look for the treasure that doesn’t perish but endures, where no moths come to eat and no worms destroy.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesus said, “I’m the light that’s over all. I am the All. The All has come from me and unfolds toward me.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: “Split a log; I’m there. Lift the stone, and you’ll find me there.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesus said, “What did you go out into the desert to see? A reed shaken by the wind? A [person] wearing fancy clothes, [like your] rulers and powerful people? They (wear) fancy [clothes], but can’t know the truth.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: A woman in the crowd said to him, “Blessed is the womb that bore you, and the breasts that nourished you.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: He said to [her], “Blessed are those who have listened to the message of the Father and kept it, because there will be days when you’ll say, ‘Blessed is the womb that didn’t conceive and the breasts that haven’t given milk.’”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesus said, “Whoever has known the world has found the body; but whoever has found the body, of them the world isn’t worthy.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesus said, “Whoever has become rich should become a ruler, and whoever has power should renounce it.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesus said, “Whoever is near me is near the fire, and whoever is far from me is far from the kingdom.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesus said, “Images are revealed to people, but the light within them is hidden in the image of the Father’s light. He’ll be revealed, but his image will be hidden by his light.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesus said, “When you see your likeness, you rejoice. But when you see your images that came into being before you did – which don’t die, and aren’t revealed – how much you’ll have to bear!”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesus said, “Adam came into being from a great power and great wealth, but he didn’t become worthy of you. If he had been worthy, [he wouldn’t have tasted] death.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesus said, “[The foxes have dens] and the birds have nests, but the Son of Humanity has nowhere to lay his head and rest.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesus said, “How miserable is the body that depends on a body, and how miserable is the soul that depends on both.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesus said, “The angels and the prophets will come to you and give you what belongs to you. You’ll give them what you have and ask yourselves, ‘When will they come and take what is theirs?’”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesus said, “Why do you wash the outside of the cup? Don’t you know that whoever created the inside created the outside too?”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesus said, “Come to me, because my yoke is easy and my requirements are light. You’ll be refreshed.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: They said to him, “Tell us who you are so that we may trust you.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: He said to them, “You read the face of the sky and the earth, but you don’t know the one right in front of you, and you don’t know how to read the present moment.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesus said, “Look and you’ll find. I didn’t answer your questions before. Now I want to give you answers, but you aren’t looking for them.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: “Don’t give what’s holy to the dogs, or else it might be thrown on the manure pile. Don’t throw pearls to the pigs, or else they might […]”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesus [said], “Whoever looks will find, [and whoever knocks], it will be opened for them.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: [Jesus said], “If you have money, don’t lend it at interest. Instead, give [it to] someone from whom you won’t get it back.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesus [said], “The Father’s kingdom can be compared to a woman who took a little yeast and [hid] it in flour. She made it into large loaves of bread. Anyone who has ears to hear should hear!”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesus said, “The Father’s kingdom can be compared to a woman carrying a jar of flour. While she was walking down [a] long road, the jar’s handle broke and the flour spilled out behind her on the road. She didn’t know it, and didn’t realize there was a problem until she got home, put down the jar, and found it empty.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesus said, “The Father’s kingdom can be compared to a man who wanted to kill someone powerful. He drew his sword in his house and drove it into the wall to figure out whether his hand was strong enough. Then he killed the powerful one.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: The disciples said to him, “Your brothers and mother are standing outside.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: He said to them, “The people here who do the will of my Father are my brothers and mother; they’re the ones who will enter my Father’s kingdom.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: They showed Jesus a gold coin and said to him, “Those who belong to Caesar demand tribute from us.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: He said to them, “Give to Caesar what belongs to Caesar, give to God what belongs to God, and give to me what belongs to me.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: “Whoever doesn’t hate their [father] and mother as I do can’t become my [disciple], and whoever [doesn’t] love their [father] and mother as I do can’t become my [disciple]. For my mother […], but [my] true [Mother] gave me Life.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesus said, “How awful for the Pharisees who are like a dog sleeping in a feeding trough for cattle, because the dog doesn’t eat, and [doesn’t let] the cattle eat either.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesus said, “Blessed is the one who knows where the bandits are going to enter. [They can] get up to assemble their defenses and be prepared to defend themselves before they arrive.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: They said to [Jesus], “Come, let’s pray and fast today.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesus said, “What have I done wrong? Have I failed?

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: “Rather, when the groom leaves the bridal chamber, then people should fast and pray.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesus said, “Whoever knows their father and mother will be called a bastard.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesus said, “When you make the two into one, you’ll become Children of Humanity, and if you say ‘Mountain, go away!’, it’ll go.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesus said, “The kingdom can be compared to a shepherd who had a hundred sheep. The largest one strayed. He left the ninety-nine and looked for that one until he found it. Having gone through the trouble, he said to the sheep: ‘I love you more than the ninety-nine.’”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesus said, “Whoever drinks from my mouth will become like me, and I myself will become like them; then, what’s hidden will be revealed to them.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesus said, “The kingdom can be compared to someone who had a treasure [hidden] in their field. [They] didn’t know about it. After they died, they left it to their son. The son didn’t know it either. He took the field and sold it.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: “The buyer plowed the field, [found] the treasure, and began to loan money at interest to whomever they wanted.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesus said, “Whoever has found the world and become rich should renounce the world.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesus said, “The heavens and the earth will roll up in front of you, and whoever lives from the Living One won’t see death.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Doesn’t Jesus say, “Whoever finds themselves, of them the world isn’t worthy”?

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesus said, “How awful for the flesh that depends on the soul. How awful for the soul that depends on the flesh.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: His disciples said to him, “When will the kingdom come?”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: “It won’t come by looking for it. They won’t say, ‘Look over here!’ or ‘Look over there!’ Rather, the Father’s kingdom is already spread out over the earth, and people don’t see it.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Simon Peter said to them, “Mary should leave us, because women aren’t worthy of life.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesus said, “Look, am I to make her a man? So that she may become a living spirit too, she’s equal to you men, because every woman who makes herself manly will enter the kingdom of heaven.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: The Gospel According to Thomas

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Estos son los dichos ocultos que el Jesús vivo habló y Didymos Judas Tomás escribió.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Y dijo: "El que descubre el significado de estos dichos no probará la muerte".

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo, "El que busca no debe parar hasta que encuentren. Cuando lo encuentren, serán perturbados. Cuando estén perturbados, se reflejarán y reinarán sobre el Todo”.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: "Si tus líderes te dicen: Mira, el reino está en el cielo, entonces los pájaros del te precederán. Si te dicen, ‘Está en el mar’, entonces el pez te precederá. Más bien, el reino está dentro de ti y fuera de ti.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: “Cuando os conocéis, seréis conocidos, y comprenderéis que sois los hijos del Padre viviente. Pero si no se conocen, entonces viven en la pobreza, y son la pobreza”.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo, "La persona mayor no dudará en preguntar a un niño pequeño de siete días sobre el lugar de la vida, y vivirán, porque muchos que son los primeros serán los últimos, y se convertirán en uno".

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo, “Saber lo que está delante de tu rostro, y lo que está oculto de ti será revelado a ti, porque no hay nada oculto que no sea revelado”.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: ¿Quieres que ayunamos? ¿Y cómo debemos orar? ¿Deberíamos hacer donaciones? ¿Y qué comida debemos evitar?

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: "No mientas, y no hagas lo que odias, porque todo es revelado a la vista del cielo; porque no hay nada oculto que no sea revelado, y nada cubierto que permanece en secreto."

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: "Bienaventurado el león que es comer por un humano y luego se convierte en humano, pero qué horror para el humano que ha comido por un león, y el león se convierte en humano".

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Él dijo: “El ser humano es como un pescador sabio que echa una red en el mar y la saca del mar lleno de peces pequeños. Entre ellos el pescador sabio encontró un pez grande fino y arrojar todos los peces pequeños hacia el mar, eligiendo fácilmente el pez grande. Cualquiera que tenga oídos para escuchar debe escuchar!”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: "Mira, salió un sembrador, tomó un puñado de semillas, y los esparció. Algunos cayeron en la carretera; los pájaros vinieron y los recogieron. Otros cayeron sobre la roca; no echaron raíces en el suelo y las orejas del grano no se levantaron hacia el cielo. Sin embargo, otros cayeron en espinas; ahogaron las semillas y los gusanos se las comieron. Finalmente, otros cayeron en buena tierra; produjo frutos hacia el cielo, unos pocos pocos veces más y unos ciento veinte.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo, "He echado fuego al mundo, y mira, lo estoy viendo hasta que se enciende."

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: “Este cielo desaparecerá, y el que está arriba desaparecerá también. Los que están muertos no están vivos, y los que viven no están vivos. En los días en que comiste lo que estaba muerto, lo haces vivo. Cuando está en la luz, ¿qué ocurre? En el día en que eras uno, te dividiste. Pero cuando te dividas, ¿qué quieres?

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Los recuerdos le dijeron a Jesús: “Sabemos que nos vas a dejar. ¿Quién nos guía entonces?

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús les dijo: Dondequiera que fuese capaz, va a Santiago el Justo, para quien el cielo y la tierra entraron en ser.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo a sus discípulos: "Si me compara con alguien, ¿quién dice que soy así?"

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Simón Pedro le dijo: “como un ángel justo”.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Mateo le dijo: "como un sabio sabio."

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Tomás le dijo: "Maestro, soy completamente incapaz de decir a quién eres".

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: "No soy tu maestro. Porque tiene bebido, te ha vuelto intoxicado por la primavera que me midió.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Lo hizo un lado y le dijo tres cosas. Cuando Tomás regresó a sus compañeros, le preguntaron: ¿Qué te dijo Jesús?

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Tomás les dijo: "Si te digo una de las cosas que me dijo, recogerás piedras y me las echarás, y saldrá fuego de las piedras y te quemarás".

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús les dijo: Si ayunan, traerán culpa sobre ustedes mismos; y si oran, serán condenados; y si hacen donaciones, harán sus espíritus.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: “Si te dan la bienvenida cuando entras en cualquier tierra y vas por el campo, sana a los que están enfermos entre ellos y comen lo que te dan, porque no es lo que entra en tu boca lo que te contaminará. Lo que venta de tu boca es lo que te contaminará.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: "Cuando ves al que no nació de una mujer, cae sobre tu rostro y adora a esa persona. Ese es tu Padre.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: "Quizás la gente piensa que él vino a echar paz en el mundo, y no saben que él vino a lanzar divisiones en la tierra: fuego, espada y guerra. Donde hay cinco en una casa, habrá tres contra dos y dos contra tres, padre contra hijo e hijo contra padre. Se levantarán y serán uno.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo, "Te bendito lo que ningún ojo ha visto nunca, ningún oído ha oído nunca, ninguna mano ha tocado, y ninguna mente humana ha pensado nunca."

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Los cambios le dijeron a Jesús: «Dinos acerca de nuestra aleta. ¿Cómo vendrá?

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: “¿Ha descubierto el principio para que pueda buscar el fin? Porque el fin está donde está el principio. Bienaventurado el que se levantará al principio. Conocerán el final, y no probarán la muerte”.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: "Bienaventurado el que vino a ser antes de entrar en ser. Si te conviertes en mis recuerdos y escuchas mi mensaje, estas piedras se convierten en tus siervos; porque hay cinco árboles en el paraíso que no cambian en verano o en invierno, y sus hojas no caen. Quien los conoce no probará la muerte”.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Los recuerdos le preguntaron a Jesús: «Dinos, ¿a qué se puede comparar el reino de los cielos?”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Les dijo: “Puede compararse con una semilla de mostaza. Aunque es la más pequeña de todas las semillas, cuando cae sobre suelo de labranza hace una planta tan grande que protege a las aves del cielo.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: María dijo a Jesús: «¿Quiénes son tus recuerdos?»

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Dijo: “Son como niños pequeños que viven en un campo que no es suyo. Cuando vengan los dueños del campo, dicen: "Devuélvenos nuestro campo". Se desnudarán delante de ellos para dejar que lo tengan y darles su campo.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: “Así que digo que si el dueño de la casa se da cuenta de que el bandido está creciendo, ellos miran de antemano y no dejarán que el bandido entrar en la casa de su dominio y robar sus posesiones. ¡Tú, entonces, cuidado con el mundo! Prepárate para defenderte para que los bandidos no te ataquen, porque lo que esperas vendrá. Que haya una persona sabia entre ustedes!

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: “Cuando la fruta maduraba, el segador vino rápidamente, se enfermó de la mano, y la cosecha. Cualquiera que tenga oídos para escuchar debe escuchar!”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús vio a algunos niños enfermeros. Él dijo a sus discípulos: "Estos niños enfermeros pueden ser comparados con aquellos que entran en el reino."

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Le dijeron: “ rigurosa entraremos en el reino como niños pequeños?”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús les dijo, "Cuando hacen a los dos en uno, y hacen el interior como el exterior y el exterior como el interior, y el superior como el inferior, y así hacen al macho y a la hembra un solo para que el macho no sea macho ni la hembra; cuando hacen ojos en el lugar de un ojo, una mano en el lugar de una mano, un pie en el lugar de un pie, y una imagen en el lugar de una imagen;

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo, "Yo te elegiré, uno de cada mil y dos de cada diez mil, y ellos estarán de pie como uno solo."

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Sus dicen: “Muéstranos el lugar donde estás, porque necesitamos buscarlo”.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Él les dijo: "Cualquiera que tenga oídos para oír debe escuchar! La luz existe dentro de una persona de luz, y iluminan todo el mundo. Si no brillan, hay oscuridad”.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: "Ama a tu hermano como tu propia alma. Protégelos como el alumno de tu ojo.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: “Ves la mancha que está en el ojo de tu hermano, pero no ves la viga en tu propio ojo. Cuando sacas el rayo de tu propio ojo, entonces podrás ver claramente para sacar la mancha del ojo de tu hermano.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: “Si no ayunas del mundo, no encontrarás el reino. Si no haces el sábado en sábado, no hay huellas al Padre.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: "Yo me quedé en medio del mundo y les aparecí en la carne. Los encontré borrachos; no encontré ninguno de ellos sediento. Mi alma se enamoró de los hijos de la humanidad, porque estaban ciegos en sus corazones y no podían ver. Llegaron al mundo vacío y planeaban dejar el mundo vacío. Mientras tanto, están borrachos. Cuando sacuden su vino, entonces cambiarán”.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: "Si la carne entró en la existencia debido al espíritu, eso es evidente. Si el espíritu entró en la existencia debido al cuerpo, eso es realmente evidente! Pero me sorprende cómo se ha colocado esa gran riqueza en esta pobreza”.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: “Donde hay tres deidades, son divinas. Donde hay dos o uno, estoy con ellos.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: "Personalizar es bienvenido en su propio pueblo". Ningún médico cura a los que los conocen”.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo, “Una ciudad construida y fortificada en una montaña alta no puede caer, ni puede ser ocultada”.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: “Lo que oyes con un oído, escucha con ambos, luego proclama desde tus tejados. Nadie enciende una lámpara y la pone bajo una canasta o en un lugar oculto. Más bien, lo pusieron en el estrado para que todos los que vienen y van puedan ver su luz.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo, "Si alguien que está ciego conduce a alguien más que está ciego, ambos caen en un pozo."

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: "Nadie puede entrar en la casa de los fuertes y tomarla por la fuerza sin atar las manos de los fuertes. pueden saquear la casa.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: “No te preocupes de mañana a noche o de noche a mañana por lo que vas a llevar.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Sus dicen: «¿Cuándo nos aparecimos? ¿Cuándo te vea?

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: "Cuando te desnudas sin estar avergonzado, y arroja tu ropa sobre el suelo y los golpeas como niños, entonces [verás] al Hijo del Vivir y no tengas miedo."

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo, “A menudo querido ha escuchado este mensaje que te estoy diciendo, y no tienes a nadie más de quien escucharlo. días cuando me busques, pero no podrás encontrarme.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: “Los fariseos y los eruditos han tomado las llaves del conocimiento y las han escondido. No han entrado, y no han dejado entrar a otros querían. Así que sé sabio como serpientes e inocentes como palomas.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: "Una vid ha sido plantada fuera del Padre. Ya que está desnutrido, será arrancado por su raíz y destruido”.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo, "El que tenga algo en la mano será más, pero el que no tenga nada perderá incluso lo poco que tienen."

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: "Venid a los transeúntes".

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: ¿Quién eres tú para decirnos estas cosas?

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: “No te das cuenta de quién soy de lo que digo, pero te has vuelto como los judeanos que aman el árbol pero odian su fruto, o aman el fruto pero odian el árbol.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: "El que blasfema al Padre será perdonado, y el que blasfema al Hijo será perdonado, pero el que blasfema al Espíritu Santo no será perdonado, ni en la tierra ni en el cielo."

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo, "Las razas no son cosechadas de espinas, ni son higos recogidos de las estelas, porque no producen fruto. [Una persona que es buena] saca cosas buenas de su tesoro, y una persona que es [mal] trae cosas malas de su experiencia experimentada. Dicen cosas malas porque su corazón está lleno de malos.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo, "De Adán a Juan el Bautista, nadie ha nacido que es mucho más grande que Juan el Bautista que no deben evitar sus ojos. Pero yo digo que quien entre ustedes se convierta en un niño pequeño conocerá el reino y se hará alcalde que Juan.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo, “No es posible que nadie monte dos caballos o estirar dos arcos, y no es posible que un siervo siga a dos líderes, porque ellos respetarán uno y despreciarán al otro.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: “Nadie bebe vino viejo e inmediatamente quiere beber vino nuevo. Y el vino nuevo no se pone en vinos viejos, porque estallarían. Tampoco es el vino viejo puesto en nuevos vinos, porque estropearía.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: “Un nuevo parche de tela no está cosido sobre un viejo abrigo, porque se desgarraría”.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: "Si dos hacen la paz el uno con el otro en una sola casa, pronuncian al monte: "Vete, y lo hará."

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: “Bienaventurados los que son uno – los elegidos, porque encontraréis el reino. Ha venido de allí y volverá allí.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: “Si te preguntan, ‘¿De dónde vienes?’ diles: ‘Hemos venido de la luz, el lugar donde la luz vino a ser por sí misma, [establecido] y apareció a su imagen.’

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: “Si te preguntan, ‘¿ eres tú?’ entonces di: ‘Somos sus hijos, y somos liberados por nuestro Padre viviente.’

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: “Si te preguntan, ‘¿Cuál es la señal de tu Padre en ti?’ entonces di: ‘Es movimiento y descanso’

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: ¿Cuándo descansarán los muertos, y cuándo vendrá el nuevo mundo?

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Les dijo: “Lo que estás buscando ya ha llegado, pero no lo sabes”.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Sus dicen: Veinticuatro tendencias han hablado en Israel, y todos hablanon de ti.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Él les dijo: "Ustedes han ignorado al Vivir justo delante de ustedes, ustedes han hablado de los que están muertos."

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: ¿Es útil o no la circuncisión?

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Les dijo: "Si fuera útil, los padres tendrían hijos que nacieron circuncidados. Pero la verdadera circuncisión en espíritu se ha vuelto rentable en todos los sentidos.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: "Bienaventurados los pobres, porque el tuyo es el reino de los cielos."

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: "El que no aborrece a su padre y a su madre no puede convertirse en mi discípulo, y el que no odia a sus hermanos y hermanas y toma su cruz como yo no es digno de mí."

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: "El que haya conocido el mundo ha encontrado un cadáver. Quien haya encontrado un cadáver, de ellos el mundo no es mentira».

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: “El reino de mis padres puede compararse con alguien que tenía [buena] semilla. Su enemigo vino de noche y sembró hierba entre la buena semilla. La persona no dejó que nadie sacara las malas hierbas, “para que no saques el trigo junto con las malas hierbas”, les dijeron. "El día de la cosecha, las malas hierbas serán obvias. entonces serán sacados y quemados. ’”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo, "Bendito sea la persona que ha ido a muchos problemas. Han encontrado la vida”.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo, "Busca al Vivir mientras estás vivo. Si muere y luego trata de buscarlo, no se puede.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Vio a un samaritano llevando un cordero a Judea. Dijo a sus recuerdos: "¿Qué crees que hará con ese cordero?"

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Le dijeron: “Va matar ala y comerla”.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Les dijo: “Mientras viva, no lo comerá, pero sólo después de que lo mate y se convierte en un cadáver”.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Dijoron: “No puede hacerlo de otra manera”.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Les dijo: “Tú, también, buscas un lugar de descanso, para que no te conviertas en un cadáver y mariscos comida.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo, "Dos descansarán en un sofá. Uno, el otro vivirá.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Salome dijo: "¿Quién es usted, señor, para subir a mi sofá y comer de mi mesa como si fuera de alguien?"

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús le dijo: "Yo soy el que existe en igualdad. Algo de lo que pertenece a mi Padre me fue dado.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Soy tu discípulo.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: “Así que te estoy diciendo, si alguien es /equal\, estarán llenos de luz; pero si están divididos, estarán llenos de oscuridad.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo, "Le digo a mis misterios a [aquellos que son almas de mis] misterios. No dejes que tu mano izquierda sepa lo que está haciendo tu mano derecha”.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: “Había un hombre rico que tenía mucho dinero. Él dijo, "Usaré mi para sembrar, cosechar, plantar y reducir mis dinero graneros con fruta, para que no necesite nada." Eso es lo que pensaba él mismo, pero murió esa misma noche. Cualquiera que tenga oídos para escuchar debe escuchar!”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: " planeaba tener invitados. Cuando la cena estaba lista, enviaron a su señorviente para llamar a los visitantes.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: El siervo fue al primero y dijo: Mi señor te invita.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Dijoron: "Antes comerciantes me deben dinero. Vienen esta noche. Tengo que ir a darles instrucciones. Discúlpeme de la cena.’

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: El siervo fue a otro y dijo: Mi señor te invita.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: “Dijeron: “Acabo de comprar una casa y soy necesaria para el día. No hay tiempo.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: El siervo fue a otro y dijo: Mi señor te invita.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: “Dijeron: ‘Mi amigo se va a casar y voy a hacer la cena. No puedo venir. Discúlpeme de la cena.’

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: El siervo fue a otro y dijo: Mi señor te invita.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: “Dijeron: “Acabo de comprar una granja y voy a recoger el alquiler. No puedo venir. Dis.’

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: “El señorviente volvió y le dijo al maestro: ‘Los que ha invitado a la cena se han excusado’.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: “El maestro le dijo a su siervo: ‘Sal a los caminos y trae a quien encuentre para que puedan cenar’.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: “Los compradores y los comerciantes no entrarán en los lugares de mi Padre”.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Dijo: “Un [crédito] poseía una viña. Lo atrasado a algunos accionistas para que lo trabajaran para que pudiera recoger su fruta.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: “Envió a su siervo para que los accionistas le pudieran dar el fruto de la viña. Se apoderaron de su siervo, lo golpearon, y casi lo hacían.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: El siervo volvió y le dijo un señor. Su maestro dijo: "Tal vez no los conocía". Envió a otro siervo, pero los inquilinos también lo golpearon.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: “El amo envió a su hijo, piensa, tal vez ellos mostrarán un poco de respeto a mi hijo.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: “Porque sabían que era el heredero de la viña, los accionistas lo incautaron y lo seco. Cualquiera que tenga oídos para escuchar debe escuchar!”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: “Muéstrame la piedra que los constructores rechazaon; esa es la piedra angular”.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo, "El que lo sabe todo, pero es personalmente cuidadonte, carece de todo."

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo, "Bienaventurado eres cuando eres odiado y perseguido, y ningún lugar será encontrado donde ha sido perseguido."

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: "Bienaventurados los que han sido perseguidos en sus propios corazones. Ellos han conocido plenamente al Padre. Bienaventurados los que tienen hambre, para que sus estómagos sean llenos.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: "Si das a luz lo que hay dentro de ti, lo que tienes dentro de ti te salvará. Si no tienes eso dentro, lo que no tienes dentro de ti te matará.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: “Destruiré esta casa, y nadie podrá construirla [...]”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: "Dile a mis hermanos que dividan nuestra herencia conmigo."

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Él le dijo: "¿Quién me hizo un divider?"

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Se volvió a sus modales y les dijo: “¿Soy realmente un divisor?”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: “La cosecha realmente es abundante, pero los trabajadores son pocos. Así que oren para que el Señor envíe trabajadores a la cosecha.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Dijo, Señor, muchos están reunidos alrededor del pozo, pero no hay nada que beber.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: "Muchos están esperando en la puerta, pero aquellos que son uno entrarán en la cámara de novia."

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: “El reino del Padre puede compararse con un comerciante con mercancías que encontró una perla. El comerciante era sabio; vendieron su mercancía y compraron esa perla única para sí mismos.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Tú, también, busca el tesoro que no perece, sino que perdura, donde ninguna polilla viene a comer y ningún desastre destruye.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo, "Yo soy la luz que está sobre todo. Soy el Todo. El Todo viene de mí y se despliega hacia mí.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: “Splita un registro; estoy allí. Levanta la piedra, y me encontrarás allí.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: "¿Qué saliste al desierto para ver? ¿Una caña sacudida por el viento? ¿Un [persona] vestido de lujo, [como tus] gobernantes y gente poderosa? Ellos (juro) se imaginan [pantallas], pero no pueden saber la verdad.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Una mujer en la multitud le dijo: "Bienaventurado el vientre que te aburría, y los pechos que te alimentaban".

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Él dijo a [ella], "Bienaventurados los que han escuchado el mensaje del Padre y lo han guardado, porque habrá días cuando dice: "Bienaventurado el vientre que no concibió y los pechos que no han dado leche".

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: "El que ha conocido el mundo ha encontrado el cuerpo; pero el que ha encontrado el cuerpo, de ellos el mundo no es digno."

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo, "El que se ha hecho rico debe convertirse en un gobernante, y el que tiene poder debe renunciar a ella."

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: "El que está cerca de mí está cerca del fuego, y el que está lejos de mí está lejos del reino."

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: “Las imágenes se revelan a las personas, pero la luz dentro de ellas está oculta en la imagen de la luz del Padre. Será revelado, pero su imagen oculta por su luz.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: "Cuando ves tu semejanza, te alegras. Pero cuando veas tus imágenes que llegaron a ser antes de que lo hicieras – que no mueren, y no se revelan – ¡cuánto tienes que soportar!”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: "Adán vino a ser de un gran poder y gran riqueza, pero no se convirtió en here de ti. Si hubiera sido yo, [no habría probado] la muerte."

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: "[Los zorros tienen guaridas] y los pájaros tienen nidos, pero el Hijo de la Humanidad no tiene donde poner su cabeza y descansar."

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo, "Cuán miserable es el cuerpo que depende de un cuerpo, y traiciona miserable es el alma que depende de ambos."

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: "Los ángeles y los poderes vendrán a ti y te darán lo que te pertenece. Les daréis lo que esperan y os preguntaréis: «¿Cuándo vendrán y tomarán lo que es suyo?»

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: "¿Por qué lavas el exterior de la copa? ¿No sabes que quien creó el interior creó el exterior también?

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: Ven a mí, porque mi yugo es fácil y mis requisitos son ligeros. Será reencontrado”.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Le dijeron: «Dinos quién eres para que podamos confiar en ti».

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Les dijo: "Lees la cara del cielo y la tierra, pero no conoce a la derecha delante de ti, y no sabes leer el momento presente."

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: "Mira y encontrarás. No respondí a tus preguntas antes. Ahora quiero dar respuestas, pero no las estás buscando.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: “No le des lo que es santo a los perros, o de lo contrario podría ser arrojado a la pila de estiércol. No neumáticos aplasta a los cerdos, o de lo contrario podrían [...]”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús [dijo], "El que busque, [y el que llama], será abierto para ellos."

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: [Jesús dijo], "Si tienes dinero, no lo mereces en interés. En lugar de eso, dale a alguien de quien no lo recuperará.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús [said], “El reino del Padre puede compararse con una mujer que tomó un poco de levadura y [ocultó] en harina. Lo hizo en grandes panes. Cualquiera que tenga oídos para escuchar debe escuchar!”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: “El reino del Padre puede compararse con una mujer que lleva un frasco de harina. Mientras caminaba por un largo camino, la manija del tarro se rompió y la harina se derramó detrás de ella en el camino. Ella no lo sabía, y no se dio cuenta de que había un problema hasta que llegó a casa, bajó el frasco, y lo encontró vacío.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: “El reino del Padre puede compararse con un hombre que quería matar a alguien poderoso. Dibujó su espada en su casa y la condujo a la pared para averiguar si su mano era lo suficientemente fuerte. Luego mató al poderoso.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Los recuerdos dicen: Tus hermanos y tu madre están afuera.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Él les dijo: "El pueblo aquí que hace la voluntad de mi Padre son mis hermanos y madres; ellos son los que entrarán en el reino de mi Padre."

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Mostraron a Jesús una moneda de oro y le dijeron: "Aquellos que pertenecen al César exigen tributo de nosotros".

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Les dijo: «Dad al César lo que pertenece al César, papá a Dios lo que pertenece a Dios, y papame lo que me pertenece».

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: “El que no odia a su [padre] y a su madre como yo no puede convertirse en mi [discípulo], y quien [no] ama a su [padre] y a su como yo no puede ser mi [discípulo]. Para mi madre [...], pero [mi] verdadero [Madre] me dio la Vida."

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo, "Qué horror para los fariseos que son como un perro machista en un pan de alimentación para el ganado, porque el perro no viene, y el ganado tampoco viene."

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: "Bienaventurado el que sabe dónde van a entrar los bandidos. [Pueden] levantarse para armar sus defensas y estar preparados para defenderse antes de que lleguen."

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Dijoron a [Jesús], "Ven, oremos y ayunamos hoy."

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: "¿Qué hizo mal? ¿Se cayó?

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Más allá, cuando el novio sale de la sala de novias, la gente debe ayunar y orar.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: "El que conoce a su llamado padre y a su madre será bastardo."

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo, "Cuando ustedes hacen uno los dos en uno, ustedes se convierten en Hijos de la Humanidad, y si ustedes dicen "¡Montaña, veterinaria!", se van.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: “El reino puede compararse con un pastor que tenía cien seguidores. El más grande estrayó. Dejó el noventa y nueve y buscó ese hasta que lo encontró. Habiendo pasado por el problema, dijo un comentario: "Te amo más que los noventa y nueve".

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: "El que beba de mi boca se volverá como yo, y yo mismo me persigue semejante a ellos; entonces, lo que está oculto será revelado a ellos."

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: “El reino puede compararse con alguien que tenía un tesoro [oculto] en su campo. No lo sabían. Después de morir, se lo dejó a su hijo. El hijo tampoco lo sabía. Tomó el campo y lo vendió.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: “El comprador arado el campo, [fundió] el tesoro, y comenzó a prestar dinero en interés de quien quisiera.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: "El que ha encontrado el mundo y se ha hecho rico debe renunciar al mundo".

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: "Los cielos y la tierra se enrollarán delante de ti, y quien vive del Vivir no sufre la muerte."

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: ¿No dice Jesús: “El que se encuentra, del mundo no es mentira”?

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: "Qué horror para la carne que depende del alma. Qué horror para el alma que depende de la carne.”

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: ¿Cuándo vendrá el reino?

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: “No buscamos vendrálo. No dicen nada, ¡Mira aquí! Más bien, el reino del Padre ya está extendido sobre la tierra, y la gente no lo ve.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Simón Pedro les dijo: “Mary debe dejarnos, porque las mujeres no son dignas de vida”.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: Jesús dijo: "Mira, ¿tengo que hacerla un hombre? Para que ella también se convierta en espíritu, ella es igual a vosotros hombres, porque cada mujer que se hace manso entrará en el reino de los cielos.

title: Gospel of Thomas
text: El Evangelio según Tomás

title: Gospel of Truth
text: 16 The Gospel of Truth is a joy for those who’ve received grace from the Father of Truth, that they might know him through the power of the Word that came from the fullness – the one who’s in the thought and mind of the Father. They call him “Savior.” That’s the name of the work he’ll do to redeem those who had become 17 ignorant of the Father. And the term “the Gospel” is the revelation of hope, the discovery of those who search for him.

title: Gospel of Truth
text: Since all searched for the one from whom they had come – all were within him, the uncontainable, inconceivable one who’s beyond every thought – (and) since ignorance of the Father caused anguish and terror, and the anguish grew thick like a fog, so that no one could see – Error was strengthened. It worked on its own matter in vain, not knowing the Truth.

title: Gospel of Truth
text: It happened in a deluding way, as it (Error) prepared with power, in beauty, a substitute for the Truth. Now this wasn’t humiliating for the uncontainable, inconceivable one, because the anguish and forgetfulness and delusion of deceit were like nothing, whereas the Truth is established, unchangeable, unperturbed, beyond beauty. Because of this, disregard Error, since it has no root.

title: Gospel of Truth
text: It happened in a fog concerning the Father. It happens (now) since it (Error) prepares works in forgetfulness and terror, so that with them it (Error) might attract those in the middle and imprison them.

title: Gospel of Truth
text: The forgetfulness of Error wasn’t revealed; it wasn’t a 18 [thought] from the Father. Forgetfulness didn’t come into being from the Father, though it did come into being because of him. What comes into being within him is the knowledge, which was revealed so that forgetfulness might be dissolved, and the Father might be known. Forgetfulness came into being because the Father was unknown, so when the Father comes to be known, forgetfulness won’t exist anymore.

title: Gospel of Truth
text: This is the Gospel of the one they search for, revealed to those who are complete through the mercies of the Father, the hidden mystery. Through it (the Gospel), Jesus Christ enlightened those who were in darkness through forgetfulness. He enlightened them; he showed them a Way, and the Way is the Truth which he taught them.

title: Gospel of Truth
text: As a result, Error was angry. It pursued him. It was threatened by him and brought to nothing. They nailed him (Jesus) to a tree, and he became the fruit of the Father’s knowledge. However, it (the fruit) didn’t cause destruction when it was eaten, but those who ate it were given joy in the discovery. He discovered them in himself and they discovered him in themselves.

title: Gospel of Truth
text: As for the uncontainable, inconceivable one – the Father, the complete one who made all – all are within him, and all need him. Although he kept their completion within himself which he didn’t give to all, the Father wasn’t jealous. Indeed, what jealousy is there between him and his members? 19 For if, like this, the generation [received the completion,] they couldn’t have come […] the Father. He keeps their completion within himself, giving it to them to return to him with a unitary knowledge in completion. He’s the one who made all, and all are within him, and all need him.

title: Gospel of Truth
text: Like someone who’s unknown, he wants to be known and loved – because what did all need if not the knowledge of the Father?

title: Gospel of Truth
text: He became a guide, peaceful and leisurely. He came and spoke the Word as a teacher in places of learning. Those who were wise in their own estimation came up to him to test him, but he confounded them because they were vain. They hated him because they weren’t wise in Truth. After all of them, all the little children came too; theirs is the knowledge of the Father. When they were strengthened, they received teaching about the Father’s expressions. They knew and they were known; they received glory and they gave glory. In their hearts the living Book of the Living was revealed, which was written in the thought and mind 20 [of the] Father, and before the [foundation] of all within his incomprehensibility. This (book) is impossible to take, since it permits the one who takes it to be killed. No one could’ve been revealed among those who’d been entrusted with salvation unless the book had appeared. Because of this, the merciful and faithful Jesus patiently suffered until he took that book, since he knows that his death is life for many.

title: Gospel of Truth
text: When a will hasn’t yet been opened, the wealth of the deceased master of the house is hidden; so too all were hidden while the Father of all was invisible. They were from him, from whom every realm comes. Because of this:

title: Gospel of Truth
text: Jesus was revealed, put on that book, was nailed to a tree, and published the Father’s edict on the cross.

title: Gospel of Truth
text: Oh, what a great teaching!

title: Gospel of Truth
text: Drawing himself down to death, he clothed himself in eternal life, stripped himself of the perishable rags, and clothed himself in incorruptibility, which no one can take from him.

title: Gospel of Truth
text: When he entered the empty realms of terror, he passed through those who were stripped by forgetfulness, being knowledge and completion, proclaiming the things that are in the heart 21 […] teach those who will [receive teaching].

title: Gospel of Truth
text: Now those who will receive teaching [are] the living who are written in the Book of the Living. They receive teaching about themselves, and they receive it from the Father, returning to him again.

title: Gospel of Truth
text: Since the completion of all is in the Father, it’s necessary for all to go up to him. Then, if someone has knowledge, they receive what are their own, and he draws them to himself, because the one who’s ignorant is in need. And it’s a great need, since they need what will complete them. Since the completion of all is in the Father, it’s necessary for all to go up to him, and for each one to receive what are their own. He inscribed these things beforehand, having prepared them to give to those who came out from him.

title: Gospel of Truth
text: Those whose names he knew beforehand were called at the end, so that the one who has knowledge is the one whose name the Father has called, because those whose name hasn’t been spoken are ignorant. Indeed, how can someone hear if their name hasn’t been called? For the one who’s ignorant until the end is a delusion of forgetfulness, and they’ll dissolve with it. Otherwise, why do these miserable ones have no 22 name? Why do they have no voice?

title: Gospel of Truth
text: So if someone has knowledge, they’re from above. If they’re called, they hear, they reply, and they turn to the one who calls them. And they go up to him, and they know how they are called. Having knowledge, they do the will of the one who called them, they want to please him, and they receive rest. Each one’s name becomes their own. The one who has knowledge like this knows where they come from and where they’re going. They know like one who, having been drunk, turns from their drunkenness, and having returned to themselves, restores what are their own.

title: Gospel of Truth
text: He’s returned many from Error. He went before them to the realms from which they had moved away. They had received Error because of the depth of the one who surrounds every realm, though nothing surrounds him. It’s a great wonder that they were in the Father, not knowing him, and that they were able to come out by themselves, since they weren’t able to grasp and know the one in whom they were. He revealed his will as knowledge in harmony with all that emanated from him.

title: Gospel of Truth
text: This is the knowledge of the living book which he revealed to the 23 generations at the end, letters from him revealing how they’re not vowels or consonants, so that one might read them and think they’re meaningless, but they’re letters of the Truth – they speak and know themselves. Each letter is a complete thought, like a book that’s complete, since they’re letters written by the Unity, the Father having written them so that the generations, by means of his letters, might know the Father.

title: Gospel of Truth
text: His Wisdom meditates on the Word, his teaching speaks it, his knowledge has revealed it, his patience is a crown upon it, his joy is in harmony with it, his glory has exalted it, his image has revealed it, his rest has received it, his love made a body around it, his faith embraced it.

title: Gospel of Truth
text: In this way, the Word of the Father goes out in all, as the fruit 24 [of] his heart and an expression of his will. But it supports all. It chooses them and also takes the expression of all, purifying them, returning them to the Father and to the Mother, Jesus of infinite sweetness.

title: Gospel of Truth
text: The Father reveals his bosom, and his bosom is the Holy Spirit. He reveals what’s hidden of himself; what’s hidden of himself is his Son – so that through the mercies of the Father, the generations may know him and cease their work in searching for the Father, resting in him and knowing that this is the rest. He’s filled the need and dissolved its appearance – its appearance is the world in which it served, because where there’s envy and strife there’s need, but where there’s Unity there’s completion. Since need came into being because the Father wasn’t known, when the Father is known, from then on, need will no longer exist. As someone’s ignorance dissolves when they gain knowledge, and as darkness dissolves when the light appears, 25 so also need dissolves in completion. So the appearance is revealed from then on, but it’ll dissolve in the harmony of Unity.

title: Gospel of Truth
text: For now, their works lie scattered. In time, Unity will complete the realms. Within Unity each one will receive themselves, and within knowledge they’ll purify themselves from multiplicity into Unity, consuming matter within themselves like fire, and darkness by light, death by life. If indeed these things have happened to each one of us, then it’s right for us to think about all, so that this house will be holy and silent for the Unity.

title: Gospel of Truth
text: It’s like some who’ve left their home, having jars that weren’t any good in places. They broke them, but the master of the house doesn’t suffer any loss. Instead he rejoices, because in place of the bad jars are ones that are full and complete. For this is 26 the judgment that’s come from above; it’s judged everyone. It’s a drawn, two-edged sword which cuts both ways. The Word, which is in the hearts of those who speak it, appeared. It isn’t just a sound, but it was incarnated (embodied).

title: Gospel of Truth
text: A great disturbance arose among the jars, because some were empty, others filled; some provided for, others poured out; some purified, others broken. All the realms were shaken and disturbed, because they didn’t have order or stability. Error was anxious. It didn’t know what to do; it grieved, mourned, and hurt itself, because it knew nothing. The knowledge, which is its (Error’s) destruction, approached it (Error) and all that emanated from it. Error is empty, with nothing inside it.

title: Gospel of Truth
text: Truth came into their midst, and all that emanated knew it. They welcomed the Father in Truth with a complete power that joins them with the Father. Truth is the Father’s mouth; the Holy Spirit is his tongue. Everyone who loves the Truth and are joined to the 27 Truth are joined to the Father’s mouth. By his tongue they’ll receive the Holy Spirit. This is the revelation of the Father and his manifestation to his generations. He revealed what was hidden of himself; he explained it, because who has anything, if not the Father alone?

title: Gospel of Truth
text: Every realm emanates from him. They know they’ve come out from him like children who are from someone who’s completely mature. They knew they hadn’t yet received form or a name. The Father gives birth to each one. Then, when they receive form from his knowledge, although they’re really within him, they don’t know him. But the Father is complete, knowing every realm that’s within him. If he wants to, he reveals whomever he wants, giving them a form and a name. He gives a name to them, and causes those to come into being who, before they come into being, are ignorant of the one who made them.

title: Gospel of Truth
text: I’m not saying, then, that those who haven’t yet come into being are nothing, but they exist 28 in the one who will want them to come into being when he wants, like a later time. Before everything is revealed, he knows what he’ll produce. But the fruit which he hasn’t yet revealed doesn’t yet know anything, nor does it do anything. In addition, every realm which is itself in the Father is from the one who exists, who establishes them from what doesn’t exist. For those who have no root have no fruit either. They think to themselves, “I’ve come into being,” but they’ll dissolve by themselves. Because of this, those who didn’t exist at all won’t exist.

title: Gospel of Truth
text: What, then, did he want them to think of themselves? He wanted to them to think, “I’ve come into being like the shadows and phantoms of the night.” When the light shines on the terror which they received, they know that it’s nothing. In this way, they were ignorant of the Father, whom 29 they didn’t see. Since it was terror and disturbance and instability and doubt and division, many illusions were at work among them, and vain ignorance, like they were deep in sleep and found themselves in nightmares. Either they’re running somewhere, or unable to run away from someone; or they’re fighting, or being beaten; or they’ve fallen from heights, or fly through the air without wings. Sometimes, too, it’s like someone is killing them, even though no one’s chasing them; or they themselves are killing those around them, covered in their blood. Until those who are going through all these nightmares can wake up, they see nothing, because these things are nothing.

title: Gospel of Truth
text: That’s the way it is with those who’ve cast off ignorance like sleep. They don’t regard it as anything, nor do they regard its 30 other works as real, but they abandon them like a dream in the night. They value the knowledge of the Father like they value the light. The ignorant have acted like they’re asleep; those who’ve come to knowledge have acted like they’ve awakened. Good for the one who returns and awakens! Blessed is the one who’s opened the eyes of those who can’t see! The Holy Spirit hurried after them to revive them. Having given a hand to the one who lay on the ground, it set them up on their feet, because they hadn’t yet arisen. It gave them the knowledge of the Father and the revelation of the Son, because when they saw him and heard him, he granted them to taste him and to grasp the beloved Son.

title: Gospel of Truth
text: When he was revealed, he taught them about the Father, the uncontainable one, and breathed into them what’s in the thought, doing his will. When many had received the light, they turned 31 to him. For the material ones were strangers, who didn’t see his form or know him. For he came by means of fleshly form, and nothing could block his path, because incorruptibility can’t be grasped. Moreover, he said new things while he spoke about what’s in the Father’s heart and brought out the complete Word. When the light spoke through his mouth, and by his voice gave birth to life, he gave them thought, wisdom, mercy, salvation, and the Spirit of power from the infinity and sweetness of the Father. He caused punishments and torments to cease, because they led astray into Error and bondage those who needed mercy. He dissolved and confounded them with knowledge. He became:

title: Gospel of Truth
text: a Way for those who were led astray, knowledge for those who were ignorant, a discovery for those who were searching, strength for those who were wavering, and purity for those who were impure.

title: Gospel of Truth
text: He’s the shepherd who left behind the ninety- 32 nine sheep which weren’t lost. He went and searched for the one which was lost. He rejoiced when he found it, because ninety-nine is a number expressed with the left hand. However, when the one is found, the numerical sum moves to the right hand. In this way, what needs the one – that is, the whole right hand – draws what it needs, takes it from the left hand, and moves it to the right, so the number becomes one hundred. This is a symbol of the sound of these numbers; this is the Father.

title: Gospel of Truth
text: Even on the Sabbath, he worked for the sheep which he found fallen in the pit. He saved the life of the sheep, having brought it up from the pit, so that you may know in your hearts – you’re children of the knowledge of the heart – what is the Sabbath, on which it isn’t right for salvation to be idle, so that you may speak of the day which is above, which has no night, and of the light that doesn’t set, because it’s complete. Speak then from the heart, because you’re the completed day, and the light that doesn’t cease dwells within you. Speak of the Truth with those who search for it, and of knowledge with those who’ve sinned in their Error.

title: Gospel of Truth
text: 33 Strengthen the feet of those who stumble, and reach out to those who are sick. Feed those who are hungry, and give rest to those who are weary. Raise up those who want to arise, and awaken those who sleep, because you’re the understanding that’s unsheathed. If strength is like this, it becomes stronger.

title: Gospel of Truth
text: Be concerned about yourselves. Don’t be concerned about other things which you’ve rejected from yourselves. Don’t return to eat your vomit. Don’t be eaten by worms, because you’ve already shaken it off. Don’t become a dwelling-place for the devil, because you’ve already brought him to naught. Don’t strengthen your obstacles which are collapsing, as though you’re a support. For the lawless one is nothing, to be treated more harshly than the just, doing his works among others.

title: Gospel of Truth
text: Do then the Father’s will, because you’re from him. For the Father is sweet, and goodness is in his will. He knows what’s yours, that you may find rest in them. For by the fruits they know what’s yours, because the children of the Father 34 are his fragrance, since they’re from the grace of his expression. Because of this, the Father loves his fragrance, and reveals it in every place. And when it mixes with matter, it gives his fragrance to the light, and in tranquility he causes it to rise above every form and every sound. For it’s not the ears that smell the fragrance, but it’s the Spirit that smells, and draws the fragrance to itself, and sinks down into the Father’s fragrance. He shelters it, then, and takes it to the place from which it came, from the first fragrance which has grown cold. It’s something in a soul-endowed delusion, like cold water sunk into loose earth. Those who see it think that it’s just earth. Afterwards, it dissolves again. If a breath draws it, it becomes warm. So the fragrances which are cold are from the division. Because of this, faith came. It dissolved the division, and it brought the fullness that’s warm with love, so that the cold may not return, but rather the unitary thought of completion.

title: Gospel of Truth
text: This is the Word of the Gospel of the discovery of the fullness, which comes for those who are awaiting 35 the salvation which is coming from above. The hope for which they’re waiting is waiting for those whose image is light with no shadow in it. If at that time the fullness comes, the need of matter doesn’t come through the infinity of the Father, who comes to give time to the need – although no one can say that the incorruptible one will come like this. But the depth of the Father multiplied, and the thought of Error didn’t exist with him. It’s something that’s fallen, which is easily set upright in the discovery of the one who’s to come to what he’ll return, because the return is called “repentance.”

title: Gospel of Truth
text: Because of this, incorruptibility breathed out. It followed after the one who sinned, so that they might rest, because forgiveness is what remains for the light in need, the Word of fullness. For the doctor hurries to the place where there’s sickness, because that’s what he (or she) wants to do. The one in need, then, doesn’t hide it, because one (the doctor) has what they need. In this way the fullness, which has no need but fills the need, is what he 36 provided from himself to fill up what’s needed, so that they might receive grace; because when they were in need, they didn’t have grace. Because of this, a diminishing took place where there is no grace. When what was diminished was restored, what they needed was revealed as fullness. This is the discovery of the light of Truth which enlightened them, because it doesn’t change.

title: Gospel of Truth
text: Because of this, they spoke of Christ in their midst: “Seek, and those who were disturbed will receive a return – and he’ll anoint them with ointment.” The ointment is the mercy of the Father, who will have mercy on them. But those whom he anointed are those who have been completed, because full jars are the ones that are anointed. But when the anointing of one dissolves, it empties, and the cause of the need is the place where the ointment leaks, because a breath and its power draws it. But from the one who has no need, no seal is removed, nor is anything emptied, but what it needs is filled again by the Father, who’s complete.

title: Gospel of Truth
text: He’s good. He knows his plants, because he planted them in his paradise. Now his paradise is a place of rest. This 37 is the completion in the Father’s thought, and these are the words of his meditation. Each of his words is the work of his one will in the revelation of his Word. When they were still in the depths of his thought, the Word – which was the first to come out – revealed them along with a mind that speaks the one Word in a silent grace. He was called “the Thought,” since they were in it before being revealed. It happened, then, that he was the first to come out at the time when it pleased the one who wanted it. Now the Father rests in his will, and is pleased with it.

title: Gospel of Truth
text: Nothing happens without him, nor does anything happen without the will of the Father, but his will is incomprehensible. His trace is the will, and no one can know him, nor does he exist for people to scrutinize so that they might grasp him, but when he wills, what he wills is this – even if the sight doesn’t please them in any way before God – the will of the Father, because he knows the beginning of all of them, and their end, for in the end he’ll greet them directly. Now the end is receiving knowledge of the one who’s hidden; this is the Father, 38 from whom the beginning has come, and to whom all who’ve come out from him will return. They were revealed for the glory and the joy of his name.

title: Gospel of Truth
text: Now the name of the Father is the Son. He’s the one who first gave a name to the one who comes out from him, who was himself, and he gave birth to him as a Son. He gave him his name which belonged to him. He’s the one to whom everything around the Father belongs. The name and the Son are his. It’s possible for him to be seen; the name, however, is invisible, because it alone is the mystery of the invisible which comes to ears that are filled completely with it by him. For indeed, the Father’s name isn’t spoken, but it’s revealed through a Son.

title: Gospel of Truth
text: In this way, then, the name is great. Who, then, will be able to utter a name for him, the great name, except him alone to whom the name belongs, and the children of the name, those in whom the Father’s name rests, and who themselves, in turn, rest in his name? Since the Father is unbegotten, it’s he alone who gave birth to him for himself as a name, before he had made the generations, so that the Father’s name might be over their head as Lord, which is the 39 true name, confirmed in his command in complete power. For the name isn’t from words and naming; the name, rather, is invisible.

title: Gospel of Truth
text: He gave a name to him alone. He alone sees him, he alone having the power to give him a name, because whoever doesn’t exist has no name. For what name will they give one who doesn’t exist? But the one who exists, exists also with his name, and he alone knows it, and he’s given a name to him alone. This is the Father; his name is the Son. He didn’t hide it within, then, but it existed. The Son alone gave a name. The name, then, belongs to the Father, as the name of the Father is the beloved Son. Where, indeed, would he find a name, except from the Father?

title: Gospel of Truth
text: But doubtless one will ask their neighbor, “Who is it who’ll give a name to the one who existed before them, as if 40 offspring didn’t receive a name from those who gave them birth?” First, then, it’s right for us to consider what the name is. It’s the true name, the name from the Father, because it’s the proper name. So he didn’t receive the name on loan, the way others do, according to the form in which each one will be produced. This, then, is the proper name. There’s no one else who gave it to him. But he’s unnameable, indescribable, until the time when he who’s complete spoke of him alone. And it’s he who has the power to speak his name and to see him.

title: Gospel of Truth
text: So when it pleased him that his beloved name should be his Son, and he gave the name to him who came out from the depth, he disclosed his secrets, knowing that the Father is without evil. Because of this, he brought him out so that he might speak about the place, and his resting place from which he had come, 41 and to glorify the fullness, the greatness of his name, and the Father’s sweetness.

title: Gospel of Truth
text: Each one will speak about the place from which they came, and they’ll hurry to return again to the place where they received their restoration to receive from the place where they were, receiving a taste from that place and receiving nourishment, receiving growth.

title: Gospel of Truth
text: And their place of rest is their fullness. All that have emanated from the Father, then, are fullnesses, and the roots of all that have emanated from him are within the one who caused them all to grow. He gave them their destinies. Then each one was revealed, so that through their own thought […] for the place to which they send their thought is their root, which takes them up through all the heights, up to the Father. They embrace his head, which is rest for them, and they’re grasped, approaching him, as though to say that they receive his expression by means of kisses. But they’re not revealed 42 in this way, because they neither exalted themselves, nor wanted the Father’s glory, nor did they think of him as trivial or harsh or wrathful; but he’s without evil, unperturbed, and sweet. He knows every realm before they’ve come into existence, and he has no need to be instructed.

title: Gospel of Truth
text: This is the way of those who possess something of the immeasurable greatness from above, as they wait for the complete one alone, who’s a Mother for them. And they don’t go down to Hades, nor do they have envy or groaning, nor death within them, but they rest in the one who rests, not striving nor twisting around in the search for Truth. But they themselves are the Truth, and the Father is within them, and they’re in the Father, being complete. They’re undivided from the truly good one. They don’t need anything, but they rest, refreshed in the Spirit. And they’ll listen to their root. They’ll devote themselves to those things that they’ll find in their root and not suffer loss to their soul. This is the place of the blessed; this is their place.

title: Gospel of Truth
text: As for the others, then, may they know, where they’re at, that it’s not right 43 for me, having come to the place of rest, to say anything else, but I’ll come to be in it, and will devote myself continually to the Father of all and the true brothers (and sisters), those upon whom the Father’s love is emptied and in whose midst there is no need. They’re the ones who are revealed in Truth; they exist in the true eternal life, and they speak of the light that’s complete and that’s filled with the Father’s seed, and that’s in his heart and in the fullness. His Spirit rejoices in it, and glorifies the one in whom it existed, because he’s good. And his children are complete, and worthy of his name, because he’s the Father. It’s children like this that he loves.

title: Gospel of Truth
text: 16 El Evangelio de la Verdad es una alegría para aquellos que han recibido gracia del Padre de la Verdad, para que lo conozcan a través del poder de la Palabra que vino de la plenitud – el que está en el pensamiento y la mente del Padre. Lo llaman "Salvador". Ese es el nombre de la obra que hará para redimir a los que se habían convertido en 17 ignorantes del Padre. Y el término “el Evangelio” es la revelación de la esperanza, el descubrimiento de los que lo buscan.

title: Gospel of Truth
text: Ya que todos buscaron a aquel de quien habían venido – todos estaban dentro de él, el incontenible, inconcebible que está más allá de todo pensamiento – (y) desde que la ignorancia del Padre causó angustia y terror, y la angustia se volvió gruesa como una niebla, de modo que nadie podía ver – Se fortaleció el error. Trabajó en su propia materia en vano, sin conocer la Verdad.

title: Gospel of Truth
text: Sucedió de una manera enérgica, ya que (Error) preparado con poder, en belleza, un sustituto de la Verdad. Ahora esto no era humillante para el incontenible, inconcebible, porque la angustia, el olvido y el engaño del engaño no eran como nada, mientras que la Verdad es establecida, inmutable, inalterable, más allá de la belleza. Debido a esto, ignorar Error, ya que no tiene raíz.

title: Gospel of Truth
text: Sucedió en una niebla relativa al Padre. Sucede (ahora) ya que (Error) prepara obras en olvido y terror, para que con ellos (Error) pueda atraer a los que están en medio y encarcelarlos.

title: Gospel of Truth
text: El olvido del Error no fue revelado; no fue un 18 [pensado] del Padre. El olvido no llegó a ser del Padre, aunque llegó a ser debido a él.
